publicationDetails.detailsText: Sherzod Shadikhodjaev, ‘The Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies and Implications for Central Asian WTO Members as Landlocked Countries’, in S.Sayapin (ed), International Law, Politics and Security in Central Asia(Springer 2026)

detail.abstract: The issue of fisheries subsidies has garnered significant attention within the global community due to its multifaceted implications for both economic development and environmental sustainability. Adopted at the 12th Ministerial Conference of the Word Trade Organization (WTO) in 2022, a new Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies (AFS) aims to prevent governments from using certain subsidies that lead to unsustainable fishing practices. As the first WTO environmental agreement, the AFS differs from the existing WTO disciplines on industrial subsidies by focusing on environmental protection and preservation rather than countering trade distortions. Once in effect, the AFS is expected to also apply to the WTO members from Central Asia, all of which are landlocked countries. This chapter discusses the negotiation history and main provisions of the AFS as well as its relevance to the Central Asian and other landlocked country members. It concludes that, despite the limited direct impact of the AFS on these countries, their full participation will support global sustainability efforts and help meet their domestic demand for fish products.

AI.tldr: WTO渔业补贴协议是首个WTO环境协议，旨在限制导致不可持续捕捞的补贴，重点关注环境保护而非贸易扭曲。该协议对中亚等内陆国家影响有限，但全面参与有助于全球可持续发展和满足国内鱼类产品需求。
AI.research_question: WTO渔业补贴协议（AFS）对中亚等内陆国家成员有何影响和意义？
AI.motivation: 渔业补贴问题对经济发展和环境保护具有重要影响，WTO在2022年通过了首个环境协议AFS，该协议将适用于包括中亚内陆国家在内的所有WTO成员，需要探讨其对这类国家的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: WTO补贴规则框架、环境与贸易关系理论、可持续发展理论、内陆国家发展理论
AI.method: 文献分析、协议文本解读、历史谈判过程分析、比较分析（与现有WTO工业补贴规则对比）
AI.findings: 1. AFS是首个WTO环境协议，关注环境保护而非贸易扭曲；2. 对中亚等内陆国家直接影响有限；3. 全面参与有助于全球可持续发展；4. 有助于满足国内鱼类产品需求
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了WTO规则从贸易扭曲到环境保护的理论框架；2. 为内陆国家参与全球环境治理提供理论视角；3. 丰富了可持续发展与国际贸易规则融合的理论探讨
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为内陆国家实施AFS提供政策指导；2. 帮助内陆国家理解协议义务与机遇；3. 促进全球渔业可持续发展合作；4. 为类似环境贸易协议提供实施参考

title: Trust in Regulation in a Time of Revolution
affiliations: Peter A. Allard School of Law

detail.title: Trust in Regulation in a Time of Revolution
detail.abstract:
In a moment when big-P Politics feel practically catastrophic, the suggestion that we should be focusing on regulation could seem foolish, or worse: it could seem like some kind of self-serving effort to pretend our work rearranging deck chairs continues to matter. Regulation can feel like the opposite of resistance, and resistance is on many peoples’ minds these days, particularly in the United States. And, the goal of this paper is to argue that failing to focus on regulation – and especially on trust in regulation, in this time of revolution – would be a terrible mistake. Regulation is at the leading edge of politics in a way we sometimes fail to recognize. Regulation is where the “rubber” of policy and aspiration meets the “road” of implementation and subject-facing engagement. Regulation is the face of government for most people in their daily lives.

This article examines trust in regulation as a core value and precondition of the modern liberal democratic regulatory state. It develops a concept of justified trust in regulation, grounded in regulatory trustworthiness—honesty, competence, and reliability—rather than in proxies such as partisan loyalty, blind faith, obedience, or resignation. The article situates this conception of regulatory trustworthiness within liberal democratic rule‑of‑law commitments to equal respect, fairness, and accountability, and shows how it underpinned late‑twentieth‑century imaginings of the “regulatory state.” It then contrasts this model with an emerging illiberal vision, exemplified by the current American President’s emphasis on personal loyalty, in‑group allegiance, and zero‑sum politics – all of which actively repudiate the conditions for justified trust. Using regulatory theory and examples from contemporary US governance, the article argues that mutual justified trust between regulators and regulated actors is an indispensable “capital good” for effective, flexible, and fair regulatory regimes. It concludes that rebuilding a functional regulatory state after an illiberal turn requires explicitly naming, protecting, and measuring regulatory trustworthiness as a central liberal value, alongside the rule of law, democratic accountability, and a basic commitment to equality.

AI.tldr: 本文认为在当前政治动荡时期，关注监管信任至关重要。监管是政策与实施的交汇点，是政府在民众日常生活中的直接体现。文章提出"合理信任"概念，基于监管可信度（诚实、能力、可靠性），而非党派忠诚或盲从。对比自由民主监管模式与新兴威权模式，强调监管信任是有效、灵活、公平监管体系的必要"资本品"。
AI.research_question: 在当代政治动荡时期，监管信任作为自由民主监管国家的核心价值和前提条件，其本质、基础及重要性是什么？如何区分合理信任与不合理信任？监管信任在对抗威权转向中的作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前政治环境动荡，许多人关注抵抗而非监管，但忽视监管信任将是严重错误。监管是政策实施与民众互动的关键界面，是政府在日常生活中的直接体现。在威权主义兴起的背景下，需要重新审视监管信任作为自由民主基础的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 自由民主法治理论：平等尊重、公平、问责制
2. 监管国家理论：20世纪末"监管国家"的构想
3. 信任理论：区分合理信任（基于可信度）与不合理信任（基于党派忠诚、盲从等）
4. 威权主义理论：个人忠诚、内群体认同、零和政治
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证案例：1）运用监管理论进行概念分析；2）对比自由民主与威权监管模式；3）使用当代美国治理案例作为实证支撑；4）理论论证与规范分析相结合。
AI.findings:
1. 监管信任应基于监管可信度（诚实、能力、可靠性），而非党派忠诚等代理指标
2. 合理信任是监管者与被监管者之间的互信，是有效、灵活、公平监管体系的"资本品"
3. 当前美国出现的威权模式（强调个人忠诚、内群体认同）破坏了合理信任的条件
4. 监管信任是自由民主的核心价值，与法治、民主问责、平等承诺同等重要
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"合理信任"概念框架，明确区分基于可信度的信任与基于代理指标的信任
2. 将监管信任理论化，确立其在自由民主监管国家中的核心地位
3. 构建监管信任与法治、民主问责的理论联系
4. 为分析威权主义对监管体系的侵蚀提供理论工具
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供重建监管信任的具体方向：关注可信度而非党派忠诚
2. 提出在威权转向后重建功能监管国家的策略：明确命名、保护和衡量监管可信度
3. 为监管实践提供评估框架：如何建立和维护合理信任
4. 为公民社会监督监管机构提供理论依据和实用标准

title: Severe Weather and Financial (In)stability
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, Bocconi University - Department of Economics and University of Perugia

detail.title: Severe Weather and Financial (In)stability

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We quantify the effect of severe weather shocks on the US economy in an environment in which the economy can switch between periods of financial stability and financial instability, like the Great Recession. We estimate a New Keynesian dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with banks and severe weather events. We show that severe weather shocks: 1) have a negative impact on real and financial US variables, sizable only in periods of financial instability, but muted effects on nominal variables; 2) are never a relevant source of business cycles fluctuations; 3) transmit mainly via a deterioration in the quality of capital.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了严重天气冲击对美国经济的影响，特别关注金融稳定与不稳定时期（如大衰退）的差异。研究发现天气冲击主要在金融不稳定时期对实体经济产生显著负面影响，但并非商业周期的主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 严重天气冲击在美国金融稳定与不稳定时期对经济的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，极端天气事件频发，需要理解这些冲击在不同金融环境下的经济影响，特别是金融不稳定时期（如大衰退）的放大效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡模型（DSGE），包含银行部门和严重天气事件冲击。
AI.method: 估计包含银行和严重天气冲击的DSGE模型，分析经济在金融稳定与不稳定状态间切换时的动态响应。
AI.findings:
1) 严重天气冲击对实体经济和金融变量有负面影响，但仅在金融不稳定时期显著；对名义变量影响微弱
2) 天气冲击从来不是商业周期波动的主要来源
3) 传导机制主要通过资本质量恶化
AI.theory_contributions: 将天气冲击纳入金融摩擦的DSGE框架，揭示了金融状态依赖的天气冲击传导机制，特别是资本质量渠道的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在金融不稳定时期需要特别关注天气冲击的放大效应；天气风险主要影响实体经济而非通胀；资本质量是关键的传导渠道。

title: Anticorruption Framework and Nigeria's Sustainability
affiliations: Rhema Univeristy, Nigeria.

detail.title: Anticorruption Framework and Nigeria's Sustainability
detail.abstract: Corruption involves activities without transparency and accountability aiming at personal benefit at the expense of others. It undermines the intentions of government and also creates opportunities for the miscarriage of justice. This bad condition can be curbed through anticorruption war driven by political will to promote national integrity and sustainability. Political will does not exist in a vacuum but can be located primarily in the legislature and other relevant institutions established to fight it. Essentially, anticorruption incorporates measures to institute checks and balances within the government and relevant institutions against corruption or perceived corrupt practices. Thus, anticorruption measures and sustainability can thrive on demonstrating political will in sufficient frequency in a highly corrupt environment over flowing with poverty. The case for institutionalizing effective anticorruption measures in a country like Nigeria where serving public officers can steal trillions of naira through many fronts, cannot be overemphasized. The investigation literature review research design was adopted for the study and the result showed significant positive relationship between anticorruption measures and sustainability. The study was not exhaustive due to lack of relevant current literature in these areas and research funding. Further study can examine the relationship between corruption and homelessness among low income public servants in Nigeria. The study recommends that the Senate Committee on Anticorruption and Financial Crimes should ensure the passing into law of Senator Adebule's Proceeds of Crime (Recovery and Management Bill 2025) to improve transparency and accountability in the handling of recovered public funds from criminals in power.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了反腐败措施与可持续发展之间的关系，特别关注尼日利亚的腐败问题。研究发现反腐败措施与可持续发展之间存在显著正相关关系，并建议通过立法加强透明度。
AI.research_question: 反腐败措施与可持续发展之间是否存在关系？在尼日利亚这样高度腐败的环境中，如何通过政治意愿推动有效的反腐败措施？
AI.motivation: 腐败破坏政府意图、导致司法不公，特别是在尼日利亚这样的国家，公职人员能够通过多种途径窃取巨额公共资金。需要研究如何通过制度化的反腐败措施来促进国家完整性和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治意愿理论、制度理论和反腐败治理框架。强调政治意愿不是真空存在，而是体现在立法机构和其他相关机构中。反腐败措施包括在政府和相关机构中建立制衡机制。
AI.method: 采用文献综述研究设计，分析现有文献和数据。研究承认局限性，包括缺乏相关最新文献和研究资金不足。
AI.findings: 研究发现反腐败措施与可持续发展之间存在显著正相关关系。在高度腐败和贫困的环境中，通过足够频繁地展示政治意愿，反腐败措施和可持续发展可以蓬勃发展。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了政治意愿在反腐败中的作用理论，强调其在具体机构中的体现
2. 建立了反腐败措施与可持续发展之间的理论联系
3. 为高度腐败环境中的制度设计提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 建议尼日利亚参议院反腐败和金融犯罪委员会确保通过Adebule参议员的《犯罪所得（追回和管理）法案2025》
2. 提高处理从掌权罪犯追回的公共资金的透明度和问责制
3. 为政策制定者提供了具体的立法建议

title: Populistic Surfing: Consensus, Monetary and Banking Policies
affiliations: Bocconi University - BAFFI Center on International Markets, Money, and Regulation and Bocconi University - Department of Economics, Bocconi University - Department of Economics (ECO)

detail.title: Populistic Surfing: Consensus, Monetary and Banking Policies

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This chapter, using a political economy approach, uncovers the relationships between populism, on the one side, and monetary and banking policies, on the other side. The analysis is based on three assumptions. First, both monetary and banking policies can produce redistributive effects. Second, political consensus can be associated with redistribution. Third, populists, being politicians, are myopic players, hence heavily influenced by citizens' financial and group heterogeneities. Given these assumptions, two different models are studied. Concerning monetary policies, a nexus between populism and central bank (in)dependence (CBI) can emerge where the populist aim to influence the monetary policy design after a macroeconomic shock that requires public bailouts. Regarding banking policy, our chapter defines populism as Democratic Rioting, in which citizens are assumed to be heavily influenced in their policy choice by psychological group dynamics. This explains why populist consensus emerges and may deliver different policy choices depending on non-banking news such as public welfare choices and immigration.

AI.tldr: 本文采用政治经济学方法，探讨民粹主义与货币及银行政策之间的关系。基于三个假设：政策具有再分配效应、政治共识与再分配相关、民粹主义者是短视的政治家。研究发现民粹主义与央行独立性存在关联，民粹主义可被定义为"民主骚动"，其政策选择受群体心理动态影响。
AI.research_question: 民粹主义与货币政策和银行政策之间存在怎样的关系？民粹主义如何影响央行独立性和银行政策选择？
AI.motivation: 理解民粹主义兴起对经济政策制定的影响，特别是货币和银行政策的再分配效应如何被民粹主义者利用来获取政治支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架，基于三个核心假设：1)货币和银行政策具有再分配效应；2)政治共识与再分配相关；3)民粹主义者是短视的政治参与者，受公民财务和群体异质性影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建了两个不同的模型：一个分析民粹主义与央行独立性的关系，另一个将民粹主义定义为"民主骚动"来分析银行政策选择。
AI.findings: 1)在货币政策方面，民粹主义与央行独立性之间存在关联，民粹主义者试图在需要公共救助的宏观经济冲击后影响货币政策设计；2)在银行政策方面，民粹主义表现为"民主骚动"，公民的政策选择受群体心理动态影响，政策选择取决于非银行新闻如公共福利选择和移民问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)建立了民粹主义与货币政策制定的理论联系；2)提出了"民主骚动"作为民粹主义的新概念框架；3)阐明了群体心理动态如何影响经济政策选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)帮助政策制定者理解民粹主义对央行独立性的威胁；2)为监管机构提供应对民粹主义影响银行政策的策略；3)有助于预测民粹主义兴起对经济政策稳定性的影响。

title: Improving Organ Procurement Operations
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Improving Organ Procurement Operations

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study how decisions made by organ procurement organizations (OPOs)—non-profits that coordinate organ recovery from deceased donors—affect the availability of organs for transplant in the United States. We develop a structural econometric model of a pivotal OPO decision: whether to approach a potential donor’s family to request authorization for donation. Our model conceptualizes this decision in two parts. The OPO first estimates the probabilities of two downstream outcomes: authorization (i.e., family consent) and transplant (i.e., whether the donated organs would be successfully transplanted). It then applies a cost-benefit decision rule that maps these estimates to an approach decision. Our model separately identifies the OPO’s beliefs (i.e., probability estimates), its preferences (i.e., costs / benefits), and the true probabilities of authorization and transplant. We apply our model to a dataset of 35,856 potential donors referred to four OPOs between 2016 and 2021. We find that OPOs missed a substantial number of donation opportunities, recovering organs from only 39% of transplantable donors. Of these missed opportunities, an estimated 16% resulted from conservative preferences, 12% from miscalibrated beliefs, and the remaining 72% from family declines. We conduct a detailed counterfactual policy evaluation to identify impactful and actionable changes to OPO decisions. We find that drastically increasing approach rates would allow OPOs to recover organs from 43% more donors, creating over $100 million in additional annual societal benefit.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究美国器官获取组织(OPOs)的决策如何影响器官移植可用性，发现OPOs错失了大量捐赠机会，仅从39%的可移植捐赠者中获取器官，并提出提高接触率可增加43%的器官获取量
AI.research_question: 器官获取组织(OPOs)的决策如何影响美国器官移植的可用性？具体来说，OPOs在决定是否接触潜在捐赠者家庭时的决策过程、信念和偏好如何影响器官获取结果？
AI.motivation: 器官短缺是美国移植系统面临的关键问题，每年有数千人在等待移植中死亡。OPOs作为协调器官获取的非营利组织，其决策直接影响器官供应，但现有研究对OPOs决策过程及其对器官可用性的影响了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构计量经济学模型，将OPO决策概念化为两部分：1) 估计两个下游结果的概率（家庭授权和成功移植）；2) 应用成本效益决策规则，将估计映射到接触决策。该框架分离了OPOs的信念（概率估计）、偏好（成本/效益）和真实概率。
AI.method: 开发结构计量经济学模型，应用于2016-2021年间四个OPOs的35,856个潜在捐赠者数据集。模型识别OPOs的信念、偏好以及授权和移植的真实概率，并进行反事实政策评估。
AI.findings: OPOs仅从39%的可移植捐赠者中获取器官，错失大量捐赠机会。错失机会中：16%源于保守偏好，12%源于信念校准错误，72%源于家庭拒绝。反事实分析显示，大幅提高接触率可使器官获取量增加43%，创造超过1亿美元的年社会效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了分离OPOs信念、偏好和真实概率的结构模型框架；2) 为组织决策分析提供了新的计量经济学方法；3) 深化了对非营利组织在医疗资源配置中决策行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 识别了OPOs决策中的具体改进空间；2) 提供了可操作的政策建议以提高器官获取率；3) 量化了改进决策可能带来的社会经济效益；4) 为器官获取组织的运营优化提供了实证依据。

title: Does Telework Widen the Abstract-Task Wage Premium? Evidence from Cross-Occupation Variation in Telework Feasibility

detail.title: Does Telework Widen the Abstract-Task Wage Premium? Evidence from Cross-Occupation Variation in Telework Feasibility
detail.abstract: Did the post-2020 telework expansion amplify or compress the wage premium for abstract-task intensive occupations? I provide a causal estimate of how telework access mediates the abstract-task wage premium, distinct from existing telework-wage studies that do not condition on task content, using a difference-indifferences design that exploits within-abstract-task variation in telework feasibility. Comparing high-abstract occupations that are teleworkable (management analysts, software developers) with highabstract occupations requiring physical presence (surgeons, dentists) in CPS-ORG data from 2017Q1 to 2023Q1, I find that the preferred specification yields a 2.3 percent wage premium for telework-accessible abstract-task occupations, stable at 1.8-2.3 percent across seven specifications. Coefficient stability analysis yields δ = 49.43, indicating that selection on unobservables is unlikely to explain the result. An event study confirms parallel pre-trends (p = 0.886) and gradual post-treatment divergence. The effect concentrates in metropolitan areas (2.7 percent) with a null in non-metropolitan labor markets, consistent with a monopsony-reduction mechanism. Sensitivity analysis following Rambachan and Roth (2023) confirms robustness to moderate violations of parallel trends.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2020年后远程工作扩张对抽象任务密集型职业工资溢价的影响，发现远程工作可及性使抽象任务职业获得2.3%的工资溢价，效应集中在都市区，符合垄断买方势力减弱机制。
AI.research_question: 2020年后远程工作扩张是放大还是压缩了抽象任务密集型职业的工资溢价？远程工作可及性如何中介抽象任务工资溢价？
AI.motivation: 现有远程工作-工资研究未考虑任务内容差异，需要分离远程工作可及性对抽象任务职业工资溢价的具体影响，理解疫情后劳动力市场变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务内容理论，区分抽象任务与具体任务；垄断买方势力理论解释都市区效应；远程工作可及性作为中介机制。
AI.method: 双重差分设计，利用抽象任务内部远程工作可行性的变异。比较可远程工作的高抽象职业（管理分析师、软件开发人员）与需要现场工作的高抽象职业（外科医生、牙医），使用CPS-ORG数据（2017Q1-2023Q1）。
AI.findings: 远程工作可及的抽象任务职业获得2.3%的工资溢价，效应稳定在1.8-2.3%之间。效应集中在都市区（2.7%），非都市劳动力市场无效应。平行趋势检验通过（p=0.886），系数稳定性分析显示选择偏误可能性低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将远程工作可及性与任务内容结合分析工资溢价，提供了远程工作中介效应的因果证据，支持垄断买方势力减弱机制在都市区的解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解远程工作对工资不平等的影响提供依据，帮助企业和劳动者评估远程工作对职业发展的影响，特别是对抽象任务职业的启示。

title: Consumption Wedges: Measuring and Diagnosing Distortions
affiliations: Wharton, Harvard University - Business School (HBS), University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of Toronto

detail.title: Consumption Wedges: Measuring and Diagnosing Distortions

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Ample empirical evidence documents deviations from the canonical consumption-savings model; yet, it remains difficult to assess the roles of different underlying distortions, such as financial constraints and behavioral preferences. We develop a sufficient-statistics approach that measures individual-level wedges between observed and counterfactual “frictionless” consumption. Since different distortions imply different wedge properties, wedges provide a diagnostic to distinguish between models. We measure wedges using administrative transactions data linked to surveyed expectations for a population of middle-income, low-liquidity US consumers. The expectations data allow us to distinguish wedges attributable to frictions and behavioral preferences from wedges driven by deviations from full-information rational expectations (FIRE). We find that consumption wedges are large and heterogeneous: the median wedge is 40% of frictionless consumption in absolute value, with 49% of consumers under-consuming (negative wedges) and 51% over-consuming (positive wedges). Borrowing constraints cannot rationalize this pattern because they only generate negative wedges. Models combining present bias with borrowing constraints, or featuring consumption adjustment costs, best account for the wedge properties we document.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种充分统计方法，通过测量个体层面的消费楔子来区分不同的消费储蓄模型偏差来源，包括财务约束和行为偏好。研究发现消费楔子大且异质，仅靠借贷约束无法解释，需要结合现时偏差或消费调整成本模型。
AI.research_question: 如何区分消费储蓄模型中不同潜在扭曲（如财务约束和行为偏好）的作用？
AI.motivation: 经验证据显示消费储蓄模型存在偏差，但难以评估不同扭曲因素（财务约束、行为偏好等）的相对重要性，需要开发新的诊断方法来区分这些模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费储蓄模型、充分统计方法、消费楔子理论、财务约束理论、行为经济学（现时偏差）、完全信息理性预期（FIRE）模型
AI.method: 开发充分统计方法测量个体层面的消费楔子（观察消费与无摩擦反事实消费之间的差距），使用行政交易数据与调查期望数据，针对美国中等收入、低流动性消费者群体进行分析。
AI.findings: 消费楔子大且异质：中位数楔子为无摩擦消费的40%（绝对值），49%消费者消费不足（负楔子），51%消费过度（正楔子）。仅借贷约束无法解释这种模式（只产生负楔子），结合现时偏差与借贷约束的模型或包含消费调整成本的模型最能解释楔子特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了基于消费楔子的充分统计方法来区分消费储蓄模型偏差来源；2. 提供了诊断工具来区分财务约束、行为偏好和期望偏差；3. 证明了仅靠借贷约束无法解释观察到的消费模式异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供工具来识别消费者面临的主要约束类型；2. 帮助设计更有效的消费刺激或储蓄促进政策；3. 为金融机构理解客户行为提供分析框架。

title: Interest Rate Risk and Cross-Sectional Effects of Micro-Prudential Regulation
affiliations: Stanford University - Graduate School of Business, Johns Hopkins University and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Interest Rate Risk and Cross-Sectional Effects of Micro-Prudential Regulation

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper investigates financial stability risks arising from banks' interest rate exposure and uninsured deposit funding. We develop a model of heterogeneous banks featuring endogenous run risk to jointly analyze portfolio and funding choices. The model replicates key empirical patterns, including the concentration of uninsured deposits in larger banks. We analyze the impact of monetary policy rate hikes and evaluate the capacity of microprudential tools to mitigate bank fragility. Results demonstrate that tightening capital requirements significantly lowers run risk. Higher liquidity requirements targeting uninsured deposits efficiently reduce run risk, provided they are met exclusively with reserves.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了银行利率风险暴露和无保险存款融资带来的金融稳定风险，通过异质性银行模型分析投资组合和融资选择，评估货币政策加息的影响以及微观审慎工具缓解银行脆弱性的能力。
AI.research_question: 银行利率风险暴露和无保险存款融资如何影响金融稳定性？货币政策加息和微观审慎工具如何影响银行脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 理解银行利率风险暴露与无保险存款融资之间的相互作用对金融稳定的影响，特别是在货币政策收紧环境下，为监管政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性银行模型，包含内生性挤兑风险，同时分析投资组合选择和融资决策，解释无保险存款在大银行集中的经验现象。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含异质性银行、内生挤兑风险的模型，并进行政策模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 模型成功复制了无保险存款在大银行集中的关键经验模式；2. 收紧资本要求能显著降低挤兑风险；3. 针对无保险存款的更高流动性要求能有效降低挤兑风险，前提是这些要求完全由准备金满足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了同时分析银行投资组合和融资选择的统一理论框架；2. 将内生挤兑风险纳入银行异质性模型；3. 解释了无保险存款分布的经验规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供了评估货币政策冲击对银行稳定性影响的工具；2. 证明了资本要求和流动性要求作为微观审慎工具的有效性；3. 为政策制定者设计缓解银行脆弱性的监管措施提供了实证依据。

title: Ten Good Governance Commandments on Poverty and Insecurity Reduction for Sustainable Peace and National Cohesion
affiliations: Rhema Univeristy, Nigeria.

detail.title: Ten Good Governance Commandments on Poverty and Insecurity Reduction for Sustainable Peace and National Cohesion
detail.abstract: This study was designed to explore the relationship between good governance and national cohesion from the perspectives of British Colonization and the levels of poverty, insecurity and infrastructural decay in Nigeria. British imperialists colonized Nigeria with the primary objective of trading and ruling. Their modern government idea did not depict the idea of good governance, and they did not take any steps for the industrialization of Nigeria. The colonial administration was merely concerned with governmentality without good governance. This probably laid the foundation for poverty, insecurity and infrastructural decay in Nigeria. However, National cohesion is an ongoing project because the Nigerian nation emerged from the collection of different ethnic groups that were engaging in conflicts before the arrival of the Whiteman. Before the time of colonization, the different communities and tribes that made up the Nigerian state today were developing in their own pace and in different ways according to their positive cultures and traditions. Poverty, insecurity and infrastructural deficit in Nigeria can be traced, therefore, to the legacy of colonialism which did not lay the foundation for good governance. There is no blueprint for good governance, but it is sufficient to state that its variables as contained in the governance black box are relevant measures and capable of reducing poverty and insecurity, improving critical national infrastructure and moving the nation towards sustainable peace and national cohesion. This approach encompasses economic, social, and political strategies and the key areas would include promoting economic growth, macroeconomic stability, political stability, international cooperation , among other critical factors. The absence of poverty and insecurity suggests a condition of well-being, when there is sustainable peace and cohesion. The qualitative exploratory research design was adopted in this study and the result showed positive correlation between good governance and sustainable peace and national cohesion. The study was not exhaustive due to lack of relevant current literature and research funding. Further research should examine the possibility of reinventing the wheels of political leadership in Nigeria to enhance national progress. This study recommends that the FGN should put in place a comprehensive industrialization policy as a central measure of creating employment, increasing productivity and reducing poverty and insecurity in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了英国殖民统治与尼日利亚贫困、不安全、基础设施衰败之间的关系，以及善治对国家凝聚力的影响。研究发现殖民统治未建立善治基础，导致当前问题，而善治与可持续和平及国家凝聚力呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 英国殖民统治、贫困、不安全、基础设施衰败与尼日利亚国家凝聚力之间的关系是什么？善治如何影响尼日利亚的可持续和平与国家凝聚力？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚面临贫困、不安全、基础设施衰败等挑战，这些问题的根源可追溯到殖民历史。殖民统治未建立善治基础，而国家凝聚力作为持续项目需要理解善治的作用，以促进国家发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 善治理论、殖民遗产理论、国家建设理论。研究将善治视为包含经济、社会、政治策略的"治理黑箱"，其变量能够减少贫困和不安全，改善基础设施，促进可持续和平与国家凝聚力。
AI.method: 采用定性探索性研究设计，分析英国殖民统治对尼日利亚的影响以及善治与国家凝聚力的关系。研究承认缺乏相关最新文献和研究资金的局限性。
AI.findings: 1. 英国殖民统治以贸易和统治为主要目标，未建立善治基础，未推动工业化，这为尼日利亚的贫困、不安全、基础设施衰败埋下基础。2. 善治与可持续和平及国家凝聚力呈正相关关系。3. 殖民遗产是当前问题的根源。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将殖民历史与当代治理问题联系起来，扩展了殖民遗产理论。2. 验证了善治理论在尼日利亚背景下的适用性。3. 为理解国家凝聚力作为持续项目提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议尼日利亚联邦政府制定全面的工业化政策，作为创造就业、提高生产力、减少贫困和不安全的核心措施。2. 提出需要重新思考政治领导方式以促进国家进步。3. 强调善治在促进经济、社会、政治发展中的关键作用。

title: Ray of Hope? China and the Rise of Solar Energy
affiliations: , London School of Economics (LSE) - Department of Economics, London School of Economics, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), London School of Economics - Centre for Economic Performance (CEP) and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Ray of Hope? China and the Rise of Solar Energy

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Do industrial policies that promote clean energy offer a “ray of hope”, increasing a country’s growth and welfare, whilst simultaneously reducing carbon emissions? We study the impact of Chinese solar subsidies whose implementation by city-regions went alongside massive expansion of the sector and a dramatic fall in global solar prices. We construct new city and firm panel data on solar policies, patenting and output. Using synthetic-difference-in-differences 2004-2020, we find production and innovation subsidies were more effective than demand-side (installation) subsidies in generating large and persistent increases in local innovation, net entry, production and exports. Demand policies did, however, reduce local pollution. To examine aggregate effects, we build and structurally estimate a quantitative spatial model with endogenous innovation and heterogeneous productivity across firms and cities, which accounts for business stealing and knowledge spillovers. Counterfactual analysis shows that: (i) local effects remain substantial at the macro level explaining 40%-50% of the aggregate changes in solar innovation, prices and revenues; (ii) social benefits to Chinese citizens exceed subsidy costs by 65% (and double this when environmental benefits are included); and (iii) although all subsidy types increase welfare, innovation subsidies are the most cost-effective.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了中国太阳能补贴政策的经济与环境效益，发现生产与创新补贴比需求侧补贴更有效促进创新、生产和出口，而需求政策能减少本地污染。总体社会效益超过补贴成本65%，创新补贴最具成本效益。
AI.research_question: 促进清洁能源的产业政策是否能在促进国家经济增长和福利的同时减少碳排放？具体研究中国太阳能补贴政策的影响。
AI.motivation: 清洁能源产业政策能否实现经济增长与环境保护的双重目标（"一线希望"）是一个重要政策问题。中国太阳能补贴政策伴随着行业大规模扩张和全球太阳能价格大幅下降，为研究这一问题提供了理想案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用定量空间模型，包含内生创新、企业和城市间的异质性生产率，并考虑商业窃取效应和知识溢出效应。
AI.method: 1. 构建2004-2020年城市和企业层面的太阳能政策、专利和产出面板数据；2. 使用合成双重差分法分析政策效果；3. 构建并结构估计定量空间模型进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 1. 生产和创新补贴比需求侧（安装）补贴更有效促进本地创新、净进入、生产和出口；2. 需求政策能减少本地污染；3. 本地效应在宏观层面仍显著，解释了太阳能创新、价格和收入总变化的40%-50%；4. 对中国公民的社会效益超过补贴成本65%（计入环境效益后翻倍）；5. 所有补贴类型都增加福利，但创新补贴最具成本效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为清洁能源产业政策的双重效益（经济增长与环境保护）提供了理论框架；2. 开发了包含内生创新和异质性的定量空间模型；3. 区分了不同类型补贴（生产、创新、需求侧）的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了太阳能补贴设计的实证依据；2. 表明创新补贴是最具成本效益的政策工具；3. 证明清洁能源产业政策可以实现经济增长与环境保护的双赢；4. 为其他国家设计类似政策提供了参考。

title: Inflation vs Inclusion: Stabilization Policy in the Wake of the Pandemic
affiliations: Government of Canada - Bank of Canada and Princeton University

detail.title: Inflation vs Inclusion: Stabilization Policy in the Wake of the Pandemic

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As the economy emerges from a crisis, macroeconomic policy confronts a dilemma: a protracted stimulus can foster a more inclusive labor market recovery, yet risks igniting inflation that ultimately undermines workers’ welfare through real income erosion. This tension amplifies in the presence of the ZLB and aggregate capacity constraints. We embed this insight into a quantitative model of the US economy. We study how monetary and fiscal policies managed this inflation-inclusion trade-off after the pandemic, contrasting actual outcomes with counterfactual scenarios. Our experiments yield five findings: (i) the trade-off was unusually difficult because policy was squeezed between these two constraints; (ii) inflationary pressures arose from the joint deployment of prolonged monetary and fiscal stimulus; either policy alone would have produced milder price dynamics; (iii) either inclusive fiscal policy or inclusive monetary policy in isolation would have been sufficient to contain the negative labor market hysteresis at the bottom of the distribution; (iv) inclusive fiscal policy combined with a more traditionally inflation-focused central bank would have achieved higher welfare for the vast majority of households; (v) welfare effects reflect mostly corrections of incomplete-market inefficiencies rather than gains from aggregate stabilization.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了后疫情时代宏观经济政策面临的通胀与包容性就业之间的权衡困境，通过量化模型分析发现：政策在零利率下限和产能约束下被挤压；货币与财政政策联合刺激导致通胀压力；单独任一种包容性政策足以避免劳动力市场负面滞后效应；包容性财政政策配合传统通胀目标央行能提升多数家庭福利；福利效应主要来自纠正不完全市场效率而非总量稳定。
AI.research_question: 在后疫情复苏时期，宏观经济政策如何管理通胀与包容性劳动力市场恢复之间的权衡？特别是当政策面临零利率下限和总产能约束时，货币与财政政策如何影响这一权衡？
AI.motivation: 经济危机后，政策面临两难：延长刺激可促进包容性就业恢复，但可能引发通胀侵蚀工人实际收入。这种张力在零利率下限和产能约束下更为突出。研究旨在理解后疫情时期政策如何应对这一通胀-包容性权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济政策权衡理论，特别关注零利率下限约束下的政策有效性、通胀与就业的权衡关系、以及不完全市场条件下的福利分配效应。
AI.method: 构建美国经济的量化模型，分析后疫情时期的实际政策效果与反事实情景对比，通过实验设计检验不同政策组合的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 政策在零利率下限和产能约束下被挤压，权衡异常困难；2) 通胀压力来自货币与财政政策的联合刺激，单独任一种政策通胀更温和；3) 单独任一种包容性政策足以避免底层劳动力市场负面滞后效应；4) 包容性财政政策配合传统通胀目标央行能提升多数家庭福利；5) 福利效应主要来自纠正不完全市场效率而非总量稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在零利率下限和产能约束下系统分析通胀-包容性权衡的理论框架；2) 揭示货币与财政政策交互作用对通胀动态的影响机制；3) 阐明不完全市场条件下政策福利效应的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供管理通胀与包容性就业权衡的实证依据；2) 建议包容性财政政策配合传统通胀目标央行的政策组合；3) 强调关注底层劳动力市场保护的政策设计。

title: Minimum Wages and Rise of the Robots
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), University of British Columbia (UBC), Halle Institute for Economic Research,  and Stanford

detail.title: Minimum Wages and Rise of the Robots

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper studies how minimum wage policy affects firms’ adoption of automation technologies. Using both state-level measures of robot exposure and novel plant-level data on industrial robot imports linked to U.S. Census microdata from 1992–2021, we show that increases in minimum wages raise the likelihood of robot adoption in manufacturing. Our preferred identification exploits discontinuities at state borders, comparing otherwise similar firms exposed to different wage floors. Across specifications, a 10 percent increase in the minimum wage increases robot adoption by roughly 8 percent relative to the mean.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现最低工资上涨会促进制造业企业采用工业机器人自动化技术，最低工资每上涨10%，机器人采用率相对均值增加约8%
AI.research_question: 最低工资政策如何影响企业采用自动化技术（特别是工业机器人）？
AI.motivation: 随着最低工资政策在全球范围内推广，了解其对技术采纳的影响对劳动力市场和产业政策制定具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力成本与技术替代理论，当劳动力成本上升时，企业有动机采用自动化技术替代人工
AI.method: 使用州级机器人暴露度指标和工厂级工业机器人进口数据（1992-2021年），结合美国人口普查微观数据，采用州边界断点回归设计比较相似企业
AI.findings: 最低工资上涨显著提高制造业机器人采用概率，最低工资每上涨10%，机器人采用率相对均值增加约8%
AI.theory_contributions: 为最低工资政策对技术采纳的影响提供了实证证据，深化了劳动力成本与技术替代理论的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估最低工资政策对就业结构和技术转型的影响提供参考，帮助企业预测技术投资决策

title: The Article 231 Central Bank of Kenya is not a Fiscal Agent of the Government
affiliations: Institute of Economic Affairs Kenya

detail.title: The Article 231 Central Bank of Kenya is not a Fiscal Agent of the Government
detail.abstract: This paper argues that Article 231 of the Constitution of Kenya (2010) establishes a constitutional hierarchy that places price stability and central bank independence above all ancillary functions of the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK), including its statutory role as fiscal agent to the government. While the Central Bank of Kenya Act designates the CBK as banker and debt-operations agent of the state, these roles derive their legitimacy from Article 231(3) and remain subordinate to the Bank’s primary monetary mandate. Drawing on macro-institutional theory and comparative central banking practice, the paper demonstrates how fiscal dominance can emerge endogenously through liquidity management, interest-rate constraints, and balance-sheet entanglement, even in the absence of explicit political interference. The analysis situates Kenya’s institutional design within broader debates on the separation of fiscal and monetary authority, highlighting how operational proximity to government borrowing can erode policy credibility and distort monetary transmission. A comparative case study of the United Kingdom’s post-1997 reforms illustrates how institutional separation between debt management and monetary policy can reinforce credibility, clarify accountability, and preserve constitutional intent. The paper concludes that safeguarding Article 231 requires more than formal independence: it demands statutory and operational reforms that constrain fiscal-agent functions, enhance transparency, and prevent the gradual reordering of macroeconomic priorities toward fiscal solvency at the expense of price stability.

AI.tldr: 肯尼亚宪法第231条确立了价格稳定和央行独立性的宪法层级优先于央行所有辅助职能，包括作为政府财政代理的法定角色。尽管肯尼亚央行法指定央行为国家银行家和债务操作代理，但这些角色从属于央行的主要货币使命。论文论证了财政主导如何通过流动性管理、利率约束和资产负债表纠缠内生出现，即使没有明确的政治干预。通过英国1997年后改革的比较案例研究，论文主张需要法定和操作改革来约束财政代理职能，保护宪法意图。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚宪法第231条建立的宪法层级如何影响央行作为财政代理的职能？财政主导如何在没有明确政治干预的情况下内生出现？如何通过制度设计保护价格稳定和央行独立性的宪法优先地位？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚宪法第231条确立了价格稳定和央行独立性的宪法优先地位，但央行同时承担着作为政府财政代理的法定角色。这种双重角色可能导致财政主导内生出现，侵蚀政策可信度并扭曲货币政策传导，威胁宪法意图的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观制度理论、比较中央银行实践、财政与货币权力分离理论、制度设计理论、政策可信度理论
AI.method: 制度分析、比较案例研究（英国1997年后改革）、理论论证、法律文本分析
AI.findings:
1. 肯尼亚宪法第231条建立了明确的宪法层级，价格稳定和央行独立性优先于所有辅助职能
2. 财政主导可以通过流动性管理、利率约束和资产负债表纠缠内生出现，无需明确政治干预
3. 操作上接近政府借款会侵蚀政策可信度并扭曲货币政策传导
4. 英国1997年后债务管理与货币政策分离的改革经验表明，制度分离可以增强可信度、明确问责并保护宪法意图
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了财政主导理论，论证了其内生出现的机制
2. 深化了宪法层级在央行制度设计中的作用理解
3. 为财政与货币权力分离理论提供了新的制度分析框架
4. 丰富了宏观制度理论在中央银行实践中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为肯尼亚央行改革提供具体建议：约束财政代理职能、增强透明度、防止宏观经济优先次序重新排序
2. 为其他发展中国家央行制度设计提供借鉴
3. 为政策制定者提供保护央行独立性和价格稳定的操作指南
4. 为宪法实施和制度执行提供实践指导

title: Scanner Data, Product Churn and Quality Adjustment
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) and Hitotsubashi University

detail.title: Scanner Data, Product Churn and Quality Adjustment

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
High technology products are characterized by the rapid introduction of new models and the corresponding disappearance of older models. The paper addresses the problems associated with the construction of price indexes for these products. Several methods for the quality adjustment of product prices are considered: hedonic regressions that use either product characteristics (Time Dummy Characteristics regressions) or the product itself as the ultimate characteristic (Time Product Dummy regressions). The paper also considered regressions where the economic importance of products is taken into account (weighted versus unweighted regressions). The indexes which were generated by the hedonic regressions were compared to traditional index numbers that did not make any special adjustments for quality change. The Expanding Window variant of a Weighted Time Product Dummy regression was used to address the chain drift problem. Finally, the estimation of systems of inverse demand functions was also used to generate various price indexes. The alternative approaches were implemented using Japanese price and quantity data on laptop sales in Japan for the 24 months over the years 2020-2021.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了高科技产品价格指数的构建方法，特别关注质量调整问题。通过比较不同回归方法（时间虚拟特征回归、时间产品虚拟回归、加权与非加权回归）与传统指数，使用日本2020-2021年笔记本电脑销售数据进行实证分析，并采用扩展窗口加权时间产品虚拟回归解决链漂移问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为高科技产品构建准确的价格指数，特别是如何处理产品质量变化带来的价格调整问题？
AI.motivation: 高科技产品（如笔记本电脑）更新换代迅速，旧型号快速消失，新产品不断推出，这使得传统价格指数方法难以准确反映价格变化，因为价格变化中包含了产品质量改进的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 特征价格回归理论（Hedonic Regression）：使用产品特征或产品本身作为特征进行质量调整
2. 时间虚拟特征回归（Time Dummy Characteristics regressions）
3. 时间产品虚拟回归（Time Product Dummy regressions）
4. 加权回归方法（考虑产品经济重要性）
5. 逆需求函数系统估计方法
AI.method: 使用日本2020-2021年24个月的笔记本电脑价格和数量数据，比较多种方法：特征价格回归（加权与非加权）、传统指数方法、扩展窗口加权时间产品虚拟回归（解决链漂移问题）、逆需求函数系统估计。
AI.findings: 通过实证分析比较了不同方法生成的价格指数，展示了各种质量调整方法的差异，特别强调了扩展窗口加权时间产品虚拟回归在解决链漂移问题上的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 系统比较了高科技产品价格指数的多种构建方法
2. 提出了解决链漂移问题的扩展窗口加权时间产品虚拟回归方法
3. 将逆需求函数系统估计应用于价格指数构建
4. 为快速更新换代产品的价格测量提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为统计机构和政策制定者提供了高科技产品价格指数的实用构建方法
2. 帮助准确测量通货膨胀和价格变化，避免因产品质量改进导致的偏差
3. 为日本笔记本电脑市场的价格监测提供了实证参考
4. 方法可推广到其他快速更新的高科技产品领域

title: The Impact of Overseas Education Perceptions, Employment Opportunities, and Socioeconomic Factors on Indian Student Migration: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: Christ University, Christ University, Christ University, Christ University and Christ University

detail.title: The Impact of Overseas Education Perceptions, Employment Opportunities, and Socioeconomic Factors on Indian Student Migration: A Comparative Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This research paper looks at the key factors that influence Indian students' intentions to pursue higher education abroad. It considers aspects like academic performance, job opportunities, social and economic status, immigration policies, and the influence of social networks. The growing number of Indian students studying overseas highlights the importance of understanding how academic, economic, and policy factors interact to shape their choices. Studying abroad is increasingly viewed as a way to access global opportunities, improve employability, and gain international mobility. Family support, visa rules, and peer connections also play crucial roles in either encouraging or hindering these ambitions. By using an empirical approach, this study provides evidence that these interconnected factors significantly affect students' plans to study overseas, offering a clearer analysis of international education choices for Indian students.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了影响印度学生出国留学意愿的关键因素，包括学术表现、就业机会、社会经济地位、移民政策和社会网络等，揭示了这些因素如何相互作用塑造学生的国际教育选择。
AI.research_question: 哪些关键因素影响印度学生出国留学的意愿？这些因素如何相互作用塑造他们的国际教育选择？
AI.motivation: 印度学生海外留学人数持续增长，理解学术、经济和政策因素如何相互作用影响学生选择至关重要。出国留学被视为获取全球机会、提升就业能力和获得国际流动性的重要途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究可能整合了教育选择理论、推拉理论（push-pull theory）和社会网络理论，探讨学术、经济、政策和社会因素如何共同影响留学决策。

title: What Threshold Should be Applied to Tests of Factor Models?
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, University of London, Royal Holloway College - Department of Economics and University of Sussex

detail.title: What Threshold Should be Applied to Tests of Factor Models?

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Researchers generally acknowledge that statistical tests must be adjusted when hundreds of factors and trading strategies have been examined. But how should these adjustments be made? Existing methods are often misunderstood or misapplied. We show that proper inference requires accounting for dependence across tests, correctly specifying the null distribution, and mitigating sample-selection bias. We develop a simple framework that avoids assumptions about the total number of tests run and yields a lower bound on valid significance thresholds - implying that researchers should employ a t-statistic cutoff of at least 3.0. In addition, we advocate using the local False Discovery Rate, which provides the probability that the null hypothesis is true for a given test-statistic realization - information that a conventional p-value cannot supply.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个简单的统计推断框架，用于处理多重检验问题，建议使用至少3.0的t统计量阈值，并推荐使用局部错误发现率来评估单个检验的零假设真实性概率。
AI.research_question: 在检验数百个因子和交易策略时，应该如何正确调整统计检验以避免错误推断？
AI.motivation: 现有方法经常被误解或误用，需要开发一个更可靠的框架来处理多重检验问题，特别是在金融研究中检验大量因子和策略时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重检验调整理论、错误发现率控制、统计推断理论、样本选择偏差理论
AI.method: 开发一个简单的统计推断框架，不需要假设总检验数量，考虑检验间的相关性，正确指定零分布，并减轻样本选择偏差
AI.findings: 正确的推断需要考虑检验间的相关性、正确指定零分布并减轻样本选择偏差；框架得出有效的显著性阈值下界，建议使用至少3.0的t统计量阈值；局部错误发现率能提供比传统p值更有用的信息
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个不需要假设总检验数量的多重检验调整框架；推导了显著性阈值的下界；强调了局部错误发现率在统计推断中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了具体的操作指南：使用至少3.0的t统计量阈值；推荐使用局部错误发现率来评估单个检验结果；提供了更可靠的统计推断方法

title: Consumer Automotive Financial Services: Structural Evolution, Market Dynamics, and Embedded Financial Risk in Global Vehicle Markets

detail.title: Consumer Automotive Financial Services: Structural Evolution, Market Dynamics, and Embedded Financial Risk in Global Vehicle Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no personal or financial conflicts of interest related to this study. No relationships with automotive manufacturers, financial institutions, or fintech companies influenced the design, analysis, or conclusions of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring institutional ethics approval. All information was sourced from publicly available market research, industry reports, and academic literature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive financial support from any organization, company, or funding body.

detail.abstract: Consumer automotive financial services have evolved from dealer-linked credit facilitation into complex, embedded financial systems that shape vehicle demand, ownership models, and risk transfer across global automotive markets. This paper presents a conceptual and analytical examination of the consumer automotive financial services ecosystem, integrating historical evidence from dealer-centric retail finance models with contemporary market structures characterized by digitalization, electrification, and regulatory intervention. Using the Automotive Financial Group (AFG) as a historical reference point and synthesizing recent global market intelligence, the study analyzes the functional architecture of automotive finance, including product typologies, segmentation frameworks, risk transmission mechanisms, and regional differentiation. The paper argues that modern automotive finance derives profitability less from vehicle sales and more from lifecycle monetization, residual value management, and data-driven risk segmentation.

title: Capital Structure, Seniority, and Risk Premia: Evidence from the London Stock Exchange, 1870–1929
affiliations: Yale School of Management - International Center for Finance and Yale School of Management - International Center for Finance

detail.title: Capital Structure, Seniority, and Risk Premia: Evidence from the London Stock Exchange, 1870–1929

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We use security-level data from the Investors Monthly Manual (IMM) to construct capital-weighted return indexes for the London Stock Exchange over the period 1870–1929. We find a significant and persistent equity risk premium of 3.7% over commercial paper and 4.5% over long-term government bonds, with significant co-movement with GDP growth. Returns decline monotonically with claim seniority: common stocks earn more than preferred shares, which earn more than corporate bonds. Both equity risk premia are highly significant, and the rolling 10-year return spread for stocks minus bonds is positive for every interval in the 60-year sample period.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 使用1870-1929年伦敦证券交易所证券级数据构建资本加权回报指数，发现股票相对于商业票据有3.7%、相对于长期政府债券有4.5%的显著持久风险溢价，且与GDP增长显著相关。回报随求偿权优先级单调下降：普通股>优先股>公司债。
AI.research_question: 1870-1929年期间伦敦证券交易所是否存在显著的股权风险溢价？不同证券类型（普通股、优先股、公司债）的回报模式如何？

AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、股权风险溢价理论、资本结构理论（求偿权优先级与回报关系）。
AI.method: 使用Investors Monthly Manual (IMM)的证券级数据构建资本加权回报指数，进行时间序列分析和滚动窗口检验。
AI.findings: 发现显著的股权风险溢价：股票相对商业票据3.7%，相对长期政府债券4.5%；回报随求偿权优先级单调下降；60年样本中所有10年滚动区间股票回报均高于债券。

title: The Composition of Blended Payment Systems and Patient Satisfaction: Evidence from English Primary Care
affiliations: , The University of Manchester and The University of Manchester

detail.title: The Composition of Blended Payment Systems and Patient Satisfaction: Evidence from English Primary Care

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: TZ is funded by a NIHR School for Primary Care Research PhD Studentship. RM and MS receive funding from the NIHR Applied Research Collaboration Greater Manchester, and MS is an NIHR Senior Investigator. The views expressed are those of the authors and not necessarily those of the NIHR.

detail.abstract:
Introduction: General practices in England are paid through a combination of capitation, pay-for-performance, and fee-for-service elements. While blended payment systems are widely regarded as preferable to single-method payment, there is limited causal evidence on how the relative composition of payment methods affects patient experience.

Aim: To examine the relationship between patient satisfaction and the composition of different payment methods to primary care providers.

Method: We obtained annual data on NHS payments to practices and patient satisfaction from over 6,000 general practices in England, from 2019 to 2023. We computed proportions of practice income gained from capitation, pay-for-performance, and fee-for-service. We used 2SLS IV regression to estimate the causal effect of decreasing the share of practice income from capitation relative to the other two methods.

Result: There is wide variation in the composition of income by payment methods across general practices in England. Shifting one percent of practice income from capitation to pay-for-performance or fee-for-service increases patient satisfaction by 1.52 and 0.32 percentage points, respectively.

Conclusion: The composition of blended provider payment methods has a significant impact on patient satisfaction. Increasing the proportion of primary care provider payments allocated through fee-for-service and pay-for-performance could improve patient satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用英格兰6000多家全科诊所2019-2023年的数据，通过2SLS IV回归分析发现：将诊所收入的1%从按人头付费转向按绩效付费或按服务付费，分别能提高患者满意度1.52和0.32个百分点。
AI.research_question: 不同支付方式（按人头付费、按绩效付费、按服务付费）的相对构成如何影响患者满意度？
AI.motivation: 英格兰全科诊所采用混合支付系统（按人头付费、按绩效付费、按服务付费），虽然混合支付被认为优于单一支付方式，但关于不同支付方式相对构成如何影响患者体验的因果证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗支付激励机制理论，探讨不同支付方式（按人头付费、按绩效付费、按服务付费）对医疗服务提供者行为的影响，进而如何影响患者体验和满意度。
AI.method: 使用英格兰6000多家全科诊所2019-2023年的年度数据，计算诊所从三种支付方式获得的收入比例，采用2SLS工具变量回归估计减少按人头付费收入份额对其他两种支付方式的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 英格兰全科诊所的支付方式构成存在广泛差异；2. 将诊所收入的1%从按人头付费转向按绩效付费，患者满意度提高1.52个百分点；3. 转向按服务付费，患者满意度提高0.32个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为混合支付系统理论提供了因果证据，明确了不同支付方式相对构成对患者满意度的差异化影响，丰富了医疗支付激励机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化初级医疗支付系统设计提供实证依据，建议增加按绩效付费和按服务付费的比例以提高患者满意度，有助于改善医疗服务质量评估和资源配置。

title: The Vietnam War and Racial Integration
affiliations: Princeton University

detail.title: The Vietnam War and Racial Integration

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Vietnam draft conscripted hundreds of thousands of young Americans into an integrated military. I combine near-random draft lottery variation with administrative voter data to study the long-run racial integration effects of coerced national service. Black and Native American veterans became more likely to marry white spouses, identify as Republicans, and live in more-integrated neighborhoods. Improved economic standing may partly mediate these effects. Effects are larger for Southerners and are precisely null for white veterans. Coerced military service generates substantial but asymmetric cross-racial political convergence and racial integration: Vietnam-era service caused about 20 percent of affected cohorts' interracial marriages.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 越南战争征兵通过强制兵役促进了少数族裔（黑人和原住民）与白人的种族融合，表现为跨种族婚姻增加、政治认同转变（更倾向共和党）和居住社区更融合，但对白人老兵无影响。

AI.motivation: 研究强制兵役如何影响种族融合，特别是在美国军队这个历史上重要的种族融合场所，通过越南战争征兵的自然实验来探究这一机制。

title: Did Foreigners Pay America's Tariffs? Quantity Discounts, Scale Economies and Incomplete Pass-Through
affiliations: Georgetown University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Did Foreigners Pay America's Tariffs? Quantity Discounts, Scale Economies and Incomplete Pass-Through

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Transaction-level quantity discounts are a pervasive feature of US trade, shaping both price variation and tariff incidence. Using administrative microdata, we show that these discounts reflect transaction-level scale economies rather than market power. Accounting for these micro-level economies resolves a key puzzle: while observed import prices rose one-for-one with 2018-2019 US tariffs, we show this was driven by the loss of scale economies as transaction sizes collapsed. Controlling for this scale effect, the strategic pass-through of tariffs to scale-free prices falls to 60 percent, implying foreign exporters absorbed a significant share of the burden through reduced markups.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用行政微观数据发现，美国贸易中的交易级数量折扣反映了交易级规模经济而非市场力量。考虑这些微观规模经济后，解决了2018-2019年美国关税期间观察到的进口价格与关税同步上涨的谜题：价格上涨主要是由于交易规模缩小导致规模经济丧失所致。控制规模效应后，关税向无规模价格（scale-free prices）的战略转嫁率降至60%，表明外国出口商通过降低利润率吸收了相当一部分关税负担。
AI.research_question: 交易级数量折扣的本质是什么？它们反映了规模经济还是市场力量？这些微观规模经济如何影响关税转嫁和关税负担分配？
AI.motivation: 交易级数量折扣是美国贸易的普遍特征，但对其本质（规模经济vs市场力量）存在争议。理解这一特征对于解释关税转嫁谜题（为何2018-2019年关税期间进口价格与关税同步上涨）至关重要，这关系到关税负担的实际分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于规模经济理论（而非市场力量理论）来解释交易级数量折扣；结合关税转嫁理论来分析关税负担分配；区分"有规模价格"（包含规模经济效应）和"无规模价格"（scale-free prices）的概念框架。
AI.method: 使用美国行政微观数据（administrative microdata）进行实证分析；通过计量经济学方法分离规模经济效应；比较关税前后交易规模变化对价格的影响；控制规模效应后估计关税的战略转嫁率。
AI.findings: 1. 交易级数量折扣反映了真实的交易级规模经济，而非市场力量；2. 2018-2019年关税期间观察到的进口价格上涨主要是由于交易规模缩小导致规模经济丧失；3. 控制规模效应后，关税向无规模价格的战略转嫁率仅为60%；4. 外国出口商通过降低利润率吸收了相当一部分关税负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为交易级数量折扣提供了规模经济解释的理论支持；2. 建立了微观规模经济影响宏观关税转嫁的理论联系；3. 提出了区分"有规模价格"和"无规模价格"的分析框架；4. 丰富了关税负担分配理论，强调规模经济在其中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的关税影响评估方法；2. 揭示了关税的实际负担分配（出口商承担了相当部分）；3. 对贸易企业和供应链管理具有指导意义；4. 为贸易争端和关税政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: Farmer Adoption and Payment Design Under Risk: Variability in Soil Carbon Sequestration Across Conservation Practices

detail.title: Farmer Adoption and Payment Design Under Risk: Variability in Soil Carbon Sequestration Across Conservation Practices

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Agricultural soils represent one of the largest underutilized opportunities for climate mitigation through land-based carbon sequestration. This study analyzes how farmers make long-term decisions about adopting soil conservation practices, such as no-till and reduced tillage, when soil organic carbon (SOC) accumulation generates additional payments, while explicitly considering risk associated with SOC sequestration variability. Using an infinite-horizon dynamic optimization model, the study quantifies the carbon payment levels required to incentivize adoption across different soil types. Results show that the required payments vary widely, from $8/ton C/year on well-drained soils to $32/ton C/year on poorly drained soils, highlighting the need for spatially targeted carbon incentives. The analysis demonstrates that risk in the SOC sequestration amount affects farmer choices: higher uncertainty increases the payments needed and can lead farmers to prefer lower-risk, lower-reward practices. For farmers who value intertemporal consumption smoothing, compensation requirements rise with the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for soil heterogeneity, outcome variability, and intertemporal preferences when designing effective carbon payment programs to promote long-term soil carbon sequestration.

title: Bubbles, Booms and Crashes in the US Stock Market 1792-2024
affiliations: Yale School of Management - International Center for Finance, Yale University and Yale University

detail.title: Bubbles, Booms and Crashes in the US Stock Market 1792-2024

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We examine the historical frequency of stock market booms, crashes, and bubbles in the United States from 1792 to 2024 using aggregate market data and industry-level portfolios. We define a bubble as a large boom followed by a crash that reverses the market’s prior gains. Bubbles are extremely rare. We extend the industry-level analysis of Greenwood, Shleifer, and You (2019) through 2024 and replicate their findings out of sample using Cowles Commission industry data from 1871 to 1938. Booms do not reliably predict crashes, but they do predict higher subsequent volatility, increasing the likelihood of both large gains and large losses.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学和市场异常理论，将泡沫定义为"大规模繁荣后跟随崩盘并逆转先前收益"的现象。
AI.method: 使用1792-2024年整体市场数据和行业组合数据，扩展Greenwood等人(2019)的行业层面分析至2024年，并使用1871-1938年Cowles Commission行业数据进行样本外验证。

AI.theory_contributions: 提供了泡沫历史频率的实证证据，挑战了繁荣能可靠预测崩盘的假设，建立了繁荣与后续波动性的关系。

title: A Three Tier Architecture for Decentralized Insurance Governance: Capital Backed Parameter Markets and Equilibrium Analysis

detail.title: A Three Tier Architecture for Decentralized Insurance Governance: Capital Backed Parameter Markets and Equilibrium Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: nil
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: nil

detail.abstract:
Insurance governance fundamentally concerns the legitimate authority to price risk, allocate capital, and absorb correlated losses. Traditional models centralize this authority in credentialed institutions, while existing decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols either replicate centralized control or treat critical actuarial parameters as exogenous inputs. This paper resolves the decentralized insurance governance trilemma by proposing the first complete theoretical framework built on a three-tier architecture of capital-backed parameter markets, extending and completing the Risk Coin framework (Yu, 2025).
The architecture transforms actuarial assumptions into endogenously discovered economic variables. At the Risk-Pool Tier, insurers commit capital to bid on parameters of an MBBEFD exposure curve. Policyholders signal their private risk assessments by declaring a coverage limit and a total premium payment; from these, an implied retention multiplier is derived after market pricing. At the Catastrophe-Pool Tier, reinsurers likewise commit capital to bid on parameters for pricing optional excess-of-loss reinsurance. The core governance innovation is a recursive design: a Catastrophe Pool operates identically to a Risk Pool, with Risk Pools as its policyholders, thereby unifying the governance logic of primary and reinsurance markets under the same capital-backed mechanism.
The ecosystem is anchored by the Risk-Coin-Fund Tier, which centralizes all capital—including the base risk premiums (corresponding to actuarial costs), policyholders’ voluntary supra-actuarial contributions, and professional investment reinsurance capital—and serves as the ultimate residual risk bearer. A core innovation is the consistent application of Risk Coin as a dual-purpose claim on the collective capital pool. RC tokens are issued to participants based on two principles: (1) as compensation for voluntary capital investment (the portion of declared premiums exceeding actuarial cost), and (2) as payment for risk-bearing, with the latter quantified by the market-determined exposure curve 𝐺(⋅). This creates a unified incentive system where capital commitment confers pricing authority, and better risk management preserves RC value.
We formalize the mechanism and prove its core properties: incentive-compatible parameter bidding, asymptotic information aggregation, dynamic stability of parameter markets, systemic resilience via an exponential solvency guarantee for diversifiable risks, and regulatory non-intrusiveness. A pivotal theoretical extension is the introduction of a protocol-native capital coverage ratio (ρ), which emerges from the recursive markets. This ratio is governed by a target (𝜌target) and serves as a real-time, transparent solvency signal. It demonstrates how decentralized systems can achieve endogenous stability while providing a direct interface for financial oversight, effectively bridging cryptographic economics with prudential regulatory frameworks. 
The framework demonstrates that legitimate pricing authority and financial stability can emerge organically from cryptographic economics where tokens serve not as speculative instruments but as verifiable, economically-founded claims on underwriting capacity and capital pool ownership. By solving the governance trilemma through recursive capital-backed parameter markets, a unified RC-based capital accounting system, and a native regulatory interface, this work provides more than a new insurance mechanism—it offers a blueprint for stable, transparent, incentive-aligned, and regulatorily-compatible financial ecosystems that reimagine the foundations of risk-sharing and financial governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解决去中心化保险治理三难困境的完整理论框架，通过三层架构（资本支持的参数市场）将精算假设转化为内生发现的经济变量，使用Risk Coin作为集体资本池的双重用途索取权，实现了激励兼容、信息聚合和系统性韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决去中心化保险治理的三难困境，即如何在去中心化环境中实现合法的定价权、资本配置和相关性损失吸收，而不依赖中心化机构或外生参数输入？
AI.motivation: 传统保险治理将权威集中在认证机构，而现有DeFi协议要么复制中心化控制，要么将关键精算参数视为外生输入，无法真正实现去中心化保险治理。需要一种既能保持去中心化特性，又能实现有效风险定价和资本配置的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 风险币框架扩展；2. 三层架构：风险池层、巨灾池层、风险币基金层；3. 递归设计：巨灾池与风险池采用相同治理逻辑；4. 资本支持的参数市场；5. 内生发现的精算参数；6. 协议原生资本覆盖率作为实时偿付能力信号。
AI.method: 1. 形式化机制设计；2. 数学证明核心属性：激励兼容参数竞价、渐进信息聚合、参数市场动态稳定性、系统性韧性（可分散风险的指数偿付保证）、监管非侵入性；3. 引入协议原生资本覆盖率(ρ)作为理论扩展。
AI.findings: 1. 该框架能够实现激励兼容的参数竞价；2. 能够渐进聚合市场信息；3. 参数市场具有动态稳定性；4. 对可分散风险提供指数偿付保证；5. 通过原生资本覆盖率提供透明偿付信号；6. 实现监管非侵入性，为金融监管提供直接接口。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出完整的去中心化保险治理理论框架；2. 解决治理三难困境；3. 将精算假设转化为内生经济变量；4. 统一初级和再保险市场的治理逻辑；5. 引入协议原生资本覆盖率作为理论创新；6. 展示加密经济学如何内生产生稳定性和监管兼容性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供稳定、透明、激励对齐的保险机制；2. 为监管机构提供实时透明的偿付能力监控接口；3. 重新构想风险分担和金融治理的基础；4. 为构建监管兼容的去中心化金融生态系统提供蓝图；5. 使代币成为可验证的、基于经济基础的承保能力和资本池所有权索取权。

title: The Art of Deception
affiliations: Renmin University of China and Tilburg University - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Art of Deception
detail.abstract: Art forgery exemplifies market failure driven by information asymmetry, whereby sellers or intermediaries control crucial information about provenance and legitimacy, and buyers cannot directly verify authenticity. Han Van Meegeren's forgery of The Men at Emmaus, which he falsely attributed to Vermeer, reveals how fabricated documentation and manipulated expert opinions can exploit a system that values reputation over objective verification. This problem is described in Akerlof's (1970) and Spence's (1973) models of asymmetric information in which uncertainty compels reliance on costly signals of quality. In the art market, provenance operates as such a signal, converting belief into trust capital that reduces uncertainty and stabilizes price formation. Empirical analysis confirms that artworks with verified provenance, including ownership history, exhibition records, scholarly publications, and expert certification command higher price premiums, are more likely to be sold, and achieve higher investment returns. Each component of provenance serves a unique signaling role that conveys credibility and mitigates risk. As repeated forgery scandals exposed the economic costs of deception, the art world adopted standardized documentation, technological verification, and mandatory disclosure. These developments transform private knowledge into verifiable information and establish provenance as the essential infrastructure sustaining trust, transparency, and efficiency in the global art market.

AI.tldr: 艺术市场信息不对称导致赝品问题，艺术品来源证明作为质量信号减少不确定性，实证显示有验证来源的艺术品价格更高、更易销售、投资回报更好，行业通过标准化文档和技术验证建立信任基础设施。
AI.research_question: 艺术品来源证明如何作为质量信号解决艺术市场中的信息不对称问题，并影响艺术品价格、销售可能性和投资回报？
AI.motivation: 艺术赝品问题揭示了市场失灵，源于买卖双方信息不对称，卖家或中介控制关键来源和真实性信息，买家无法直接验证真伪。Han Van Meegeren伪造Vermeer作品等案例表明，伪造文件和操纵专家意见会利用重视声誉而非客观验证的系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Akerlof（1970）和Spence（1973）的信息不对称模型，不确定性迫使依赖昂贵的质量信号。在艺术市场中，来源证明作为此类信号，将信念转化为信任资本，减少不确定性并稳定价格形成。
AI.method: 实证分析验证艺术品来源证明对市场表现的影响，包括所有权历史、展览记录、学术出版物和专家认证等组成部分。
AI.findings: 具有验证来源的艺术品（包括所有权历史、展览记录、学术出版物和专家认证）获得更高的价格溢价，更有可能被销售，并实现更高的投资回报。来源证明的每个组成部分都发挥独特的信号作用，传达可信度并降低风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息不对称理论应用于艺术市场，具体化来源证明作为质量信号的作用机制，阐明信任资本在价格形成中的功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 艺术界通过采用标准化文档、技术验证和强制披露来应对赝品丑闻的经济成本，这些发展将私人知识转化为可验证信息，建立来源证明作为维持全球艺术市场信任、透明度和效率的重要基础设施。

title: When Benchmarks Fail: The Causes and Consequences of Negative Oil Prices
affiliations: , University of Oregon - Department of Finance, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Babson College

detail.title: When Benchmarks Fail: The Causes and Consequences of Negative Oil Prices

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
On April 20, 2020, the crude oil benchmark in North America, the West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures contract for delivery in Cushing, Oklahoma, settled below zero for the first time in history. We combine new empirical evidence with a stylized theoretical model to show that a key catalyst was the accumulation of unusually large long positions in the expiring contract held by uninformed financial traders unable to take physical delivery. These positions distorted the demand signal in the futures market, intensifying pressure on the limited storage capacity and precipitating a sharp price dislocation. We then document that this dislocation significantly influenced oil production decisions through contractual exposure to WTI-based pricing. Even oil producers far from Cushing that were not directly impacted by the storage constraints responded with sharp output curtailments in the face of heightened benchmark risk. Our findings highlight how transitory futures price dislocations due to noise trader demand can have real economic consequences.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 2020年4月20日WTI原油期货首次跌破零值，研究发现主要原因是无法实物交割的非知情金融交易者在到期合约中积累了异常大规模多头头寸，扭曲了期货市场需求信号，加剧了存储压力，导致价格错位。这种价格错位通过WTI定价机制影响了石油生产决策，即使远离库欣的产油商也因基准风险而大幅减产。

AI.method: 结合新的经验证据与程式化理论模型，分析交易数据、持仓数据、存储容量数据，并研究价格错位对石油生产决策的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 无法实物交割的非知情金融交易者在到期合约中积累了异常大规模多头头寸是关键催化剂；2. 这些头寸扭曲了期货市场需求信号，加剧了有限的存储容量压力，导致价格错位；3. 这种价格错位通过WTI定价机制显著影响石油生产决策，即使远离库欣的产油商也因基准风险而大幅减产。
