title: Equity Financing and Exports: Evidence from IPO Approvals in China
affiliations: HKUST Business School, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology - School of Business and Management, Department of Economics; HKUST IEMS (Institute for Emerging Market Studies), City University of Hong Kong (CityU) and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance

detail.title: Equity Financing and Exports: Evidence from IPO Approvals in China

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
While finance theory distinguishes the roles of equity and debt in supporting firm growth, their differential impacts on international trade remain underexplored. This study provides the first empirical analysis of how access to equity financing affects firm exports. We leverage the unique institutional setting in China, where initial public offerings (IPOs) require stringent regulatory approval, ensuring that only qualified firms advance to the final review stage. Our empirical strategy compares the export performance of successful IPO applicants with that of “near misses"—applicants rejected at the final review meetings. To sharpen identification, we utilize meeting records to exclude rejections citing concerns about future revenue growth or profitability risks, as these may entail unobserved shocks to export performance. Our cohort based difference-in-differences analysis reveals that IPO approval leads to a significant annualized increase of more than 6% in firm exports over the subsequent six years. Distinct from previous findings on debt financing, IPO approval primarily affects the extensive margin, enabling firms to expand into more destination-product markets. Mechanism tests suggest that IPOs enhance exports by financing intangible investments and fostering risk-taking activities.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次实证分析了股权融资对企业出口的影响。利用中国IPO审批制度，比较成功IPO申请者与"差点成功"被拒企业的出口表现，发现IPO批准使企业出口在随后六年年均增长超过6%，主要通过扩展边际（进入更多目的地-产品市场）而非集约边际实现。
AI.research_question: 股权融资（特别是通过IPO）如何影响企业的出口表现？与债务融资的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 金融理论区分了股权和债务在支持企业增长中的不同作用，但它们对国际贸易的差异化影响尚未得到充分探索。现有研究主要关注债务融资对企业出口的影响，而对股权融资（特别是IPO）如何影响企业出口缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融理论中股权与债务的差异化作用框架，探讨股权融资（特别是IPO）对企业出口决策的影响机制，包括融资约束缓解、风险承担能力增强、无形资产投资等方面。
AI.method: 利用中国IPO审批制度的准自然实验，采用队列双重差分法（cohort based difference-in-differences）。比较成功IPO申请者与"差点成功"被拒企业（在最终审核阶段被拒，且排除因未来收入增长或盈利能力风险担忧而被拒的企业）的出口表现。
AI.findings: 1. IPO批准使企业出口在随后六年年均增长超过6%；2. 与债务融资主要影响集约边际不同，IPO主要影响扩展边际，使企业能够进入更多目的地-产品市场；3. 机制分析表明，IPO通过为无形资产投资提供资金和促进风险承担活动来增强出口能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供了股权融资（IPO）对企业出口影响的实证证据；2. 区分了股权融资与债务融资对企业出口的不同影响机制；3. 丰富了金融与国际贸易交叉领域的研究，为理解融资结构如何影响企业国际化决策提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业决策者提供了关于IPO如何促进出口扩张的实证依据；2. 为政策制定者设计支持企业国际化的融资政策提供了参考；3. 为投资者理解企业IPO后的增长路径提供了新维度。

title: Efficiency, Insurance, and Redistribution Effects of Government Policies
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis - Department of Economics, University of Oregon - Department of Economics, University of Chicago and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics, Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Efficiency, Insurance, and Redistribution Effects of Government Policies

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper decomposes welfare measures of policy reforms into parts attributable to redistribution and parts due to efficiency. We further decompose efficiency into subcomponents such as gains from better insurance against idiosyncratic and aggregate risk. Our decomposition of welfare measures associated with alternative feasible allocations is cast in terms of a coordinate system that uses generalized Pareto–Negishi weights to capture inequality and production and consumption wedges to capture distortions. Our decomposition has several desirable properties. It attributes welfare changes from movements along a Pareto frontier to redistribution; it attributes negative efficiency changes to movements away from the Pareto frontier; and it produces subcomponent shares of welfare changes that are numeraire-invariant and symmetric with respect to the direction of the reform. Our decomposition can be explained in terms of an implicit tax-and-transfer system in which redistribution captures real income changes, efficiency captures deadweight losses, and output costs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文将政策改革的福利衡量指标分解为可归因于再分配的部分和效率部分，并将效率进一步分解为应对异质性和总体风险的更好保险等子成分。
AI.research_question: 如何将政策改革的福利衡量指标系统地分解为再分配和效率两个组成部分，并进一步分解效率的子成分？
AI.motivation: 需要一种系统的方法来区分政策改革中的再分配效应和效率效应，以便更好地理解和评估政策变化对福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用广义帕累托-根岸权重来捕捉不平等，使用生产和消费楔子来捕捉扭曲，构建了一个坐标系统来分解福利衡量指标。
AI.method: 理论分解方法，将福利变化分解为再分配部分和效率部分，效率部分进一步分解为应对异质性和总体风险的保险收益等子成分。
AI.findings: 该分解方法具有几个理想特性：将帕累托前沿上的移动归因于再分配；将负效率变化归因于远离帕累托前沿的移动；产生的福利变化子成分份额具有计价不变性和改革方向对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统分解福利衡量指标的理论框架，能够清晰区分再分配和效率效应，为政策分析提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 该分解方法可以用隐含的税收和转移系统来解释，其中再分配捕捉实际收入变化，效率捕捉无谓损失和产出成本，有助于政策制定者更好地评估改革方案。

title: Do Investors Care About Non-Executive Employee Compensation? Evidence from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
affiliations: CUNY Baruch College, Harvard Business School, School of Accounting,Nanjing University of Finance and Economics  and Florida State University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Do Investors Care About Non-Executive Employee Compensation? Evidence from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
detail.abstract: We examine investors’ reactions to firms’ increases in employee compensation in response to the 2017 reduction in the U.S. corporate tax rate. While short-run returns around announcements are, on average, negative, this effect is driven by firms that announce one-time bonuses, as opposed to those that announce long-term compensation increases. These findings are consistent with investors perceiving one-time compensation as not incentivizing employees’ future actions. In fact, firms announcing long-term compensation increases experience significantly higher short- and long-run stock performance, as well as higher accounting performance, than firms announcing one-time bonuses. Finally, announcement firms experience fewer negative employee incidents and lower employee turnover in the year after announcement, suggesting potential value-creation channels. This study provides causal evidence of how compensation practices affect firm value.

AI.tldr: 研究投资者对企业在2017年美国公司税率降低后增加员工薪酬的反应。发现宣布一次性奖金的公司短期回报为负，而宣布长期薪酬增长的公司则获得更好的短期和长期股票表现及会计业绩。
AI.research_question: 投资者如何对不同类型的员工薪酬增加（一次性奖金 vs 长期薪酬增长）做出反应？这些薪酬实践如何影响公司价值？
AI.motivation: 2017年美国公司税率降低为企业提供了额外资金，许多公司选择增加员工薪酬。研究投资者对这些薪酬决策的反应，可以揭示薪酬实践如何影响公司价值创造。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于激励理论和信号理论，分析不同类型薪酬（一次性奖金 vs 长期增长）对员工激励的影响差异，以及投资者如何解读这些信号。
AI.method: 利用2017年美国公司税率降低的自然实验，分析宣布薪酬增加公司的股票市场反应、会计业绩、员工事件和离职率等数据。
AI.findings: 1. 宣布一次性奖金的公司短期回报为负；2. 宣布长期薪酬增长的公司获得更好的短期和长期股票表现及会计业绩；3. 宣布薪酬增加的公司员工负面事件和离职率降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了薪酬实践影响公司价值的因果证据，区分了不同类型薪酬（一次性 vs 长期）的激励效果差异，丰富了激励理论和信号理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计薪酬策略提供指导：长期薪酬增长比一次性奖金更能创造价值；为投资者评估公司薪酬决策提供分析框架。

title: Geoeconomic Competition and Capital Reallocation in Global FX Funding
affiliations: Johns Hopkins Carey Business School and The Wharton School

detail.title: Geoeconomic Competition and Capital Reallocation in Global FX Funding

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study geoeconomic competition and capital reallocation in global financial markets, using the foreign exchange (FX) funding market as our empirical setting. FX funding, obtained by borrowing one currency while pledging another through FX swaps, is instrumental to cross-border investment and provides high-frequency measures of capital reallocation. Countries compete for FX funding through policy actions that shift investment returns or funding costs, thereby inducing global portfolio rebalancing by private investors. We quantify this competition by measuring how one country’s inflow responds to another country’s actions, which we call “reallocation exposure.” Because observed funding flows reflect common shocks and strategic interactions across countries, bilateral influence is difficult to identify. We resolve this challenge by identifying “funding fronts,” the independent margins of portfolio adjustment that enable systematic estimation of reallocation exposure. Applying our framework to a proprietary dataset, we find that FX funding competition is concentrated in a small number of funding fronts, with a dominant U.S. dollar front accounting for most capital reallocation. Consequently, changes in U.S. conditions generate disproportionately large reallocations elsewhere. We use reallocation exposure to construct time-varying measures of geoeconomic power and show that variations systematically track major monetary, fiscal, and geopolitical events. Finally, we characterize the network of financial competition and cooperation and show that strategic responses implied by reallocation exposure align with cross-country movements in policy rates.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过外汇融资市场分析地缘经济竞争与资本再配置，提出了"再配置暴露度"概念来衡量国家间资本流动的相互影响，发现美元主导了全球资本再配置，并构建了地缘经济权力的时变度量指标。
AI.research_question: 国家间如何通过地缘经济竞争影响全球资本再配置？如何量化一个国家资本流入对另一个国家政策行动的响应程度？
AI.motivation: 理解全球金融市场中地缘经济竞争如何驱动资本再配置，以及如何准确识别国家间的双边影响，这对于分析全球金融稳定性和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外汇融资市场的资本流动理论，结合地缘经济学和国际金融理论，构建了"再配置暴露度"和"融资前沿"的概念框架来分析国家间的竞争关系。
AI.method: 使用外汇融资市场的高频数据，通过识别"融资前沿"（独立的投资组合调整边际）来系统估计再配置暴露度，并应用专有数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 外汇融资竞争集中在少数融资前沿，美元主导的前沿占资本再配置的大部分；2) 美国条件变化导致其他地区不成比例的大规模资本再配置；3) 再配置暴露度能有效追踪主要货币、财政和地缘政治事件；4) 金融竞争网络中的战略反应与政策利率的跨国变动一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"再配置暴露度"和"融资前沿"的新概念框架，为量化国家间金融竞争提供了系统方法，丰富了地缘经济学和国际金融理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 构建了时变的地缘经济权力度量指标；2) 为政策制定者提供了分析金融竞争和资本流动的工具；3) 揭示了美元在全球金融体系中的主导地位及其对其他国家的影响。

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Some Long-Horizon Macroeconomic Forecasts
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Economics

detail.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Some Long-Horizon Macroeconomic Forecasts

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We use long-run annual cross-country data for 10 macroeconomic variables to evaluate the long-horizon forecast distributions of six forecasting models. The variables we use range from ones having little serial correlation to ones having persistence consistent with unit roots. Our forecasting models include simple time series models and frequency domain models developed in Müller and Watson (2016). For plausibly stationary variables, an AR(1) model and a frequency domain model that does not require the user to take a stand on the order of integration appear reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years. For plausibly non-stationary variables, a random walk model appears reasonably well calibrated for forecast horizons of 10 and 25 years.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用长期年度跨国数据评估六种预测模型在长期预测分布上的表现，发现对于平稳变量，AR(1)模型和频率域模型在10年和25年预测期表现良好；对于非平稳变量，随机游走模型表现较好。
AI.research_question: 不同预测模型在长期预测分布上的校准效果如何？对于不同类型（平稳vs非平稳）的宏观经济变量，哪些模型在长期预测中表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 长期宏观经济预测在政策制定和投资决策中至关重要，但现有研究对长期预测分布的校准效果了解有限。需要评估不同模型在长期预测中的表现，特别是对于不同类型的时间序列数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列预测理论、单位根理论、频率域分析、预测校准理论。基于Müller和Watson（2016）开发的频率域模型，该模型不需要用户预先确定变量的积分阶数。
AI.method: 使用长期年度跨国数据，涵盖10个宏观经济变量，评估六种预测模型的长期预测分布。变量范围从几乎没有序列相关性的变量到具有单位根一致性的持久性变量。预测模型包括简单时间序列模型和频率域模型。评估10年和25年预测期的校准效果。
AI.findings: 对于可能平稳的变量，AR(1)模型和频率域模型在10年和25年预测期表现出合理的校准效果。对于可能非平稳的变量，随机游走模型在相同预测期表现出合理的校准效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于长期预测分布校准的实证证据；验证了不同模型对不同类型时间序列数据的适用性；扩展了频率域模型在长期预测中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和分析师提供了选择长期预测模型的指导；帮助用户根据变量特性（平稳vs非平稳）选择合适的预测方法；提高了长期宏观经济预测的可靠性。

title: Multidimensional Signaling and the Rise of Cultural Politics
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics,  and University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy

detail.title: Multidimensional Signaling and the Rise of Cultural Politics

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In turbulent times, political labels become increasingly uninformative about politicians’ true policy preferences or their ability to withstand the influence of special interest groups. We offer a model in which politicians use campaign rhetoric to signal their political preferences in multiple dimensions. In equilibrium, the less popular types try to pool with the more popular ones, whereas the more popular types seek to separate themselves. The ability of voters to process information shapes politicians’ campaign rhetoric. If the signals on the cultural dimension are more precise, politicians signal more there, even if the economy is more important to voters. The unpopular type benefits from increased conformity, which bridges the candidates’ rhetoric and makes it more difficult for voters to make an informed decision.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在动荡时期，政治标签难以反映政客的真实政策偏好或抵抗特殊利益集团影响的能力。本文构建了一个模型，政客通过竞选言论在多维度上传递其政治偏好信号。在均衡中，不受欢迎的类型试图与受欢迎的类型混同，而受欢迎的类型则寻求区分自己。选民处理信息的能力塑造了政客的竞选言论。如果文化维度的信号更精确，政客会更多在该维度上传递信号，即使经济对选民更重要。不受欢迎的类型从增加的趋同性中获益，这模糊了候选人的言论差异，使选民更难做出知情决策。
AI.research_question: 在政治标签信息含量下降的动荡时期，政客如何通过竞选言论在多维度上传递其真实政策偏好信号？选民的信息处理能力如何影响政客的竞选策略？
AI.motivation: 在政治动荡时期，传统的政治标签（如左翼/右翼）变得不再可靠，难以反映政客的真实政策偏好或抵抗特殊利益集团影响的能力。这导致选民难以做出知情投票决策，需要理解政客如何通过竞选言论传递信号以及选民信息处理能力如何影响这一过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论（Signaling Theory）：政客通过竞选言论在多维度上传递其政治偏好信号；博弈论均衡分析：不同类型政客（受欢迎vs不受欢迎）的策略互动；信息经济学：选民信息处理能力对信号传递效率的影响；多维政策空间分析：经济维度与文化维度的信号精确性差异。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建形式化博弈论模型，分析政客在多维度政策空间中的信号传递策略；均衡分析：求解分离均衡与混同均衡条件；比较静态分析：考察信号精确性、选民信息处理能力等参数变化对均衡结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 不受欢迎的政客类型倾向于与受欢迎类型混同，而受欢迎类型寻求区分自己；2. 选民信息处理能力直接影响政客的竞选言论策略；3. 信号更精确的维度（如文化维度）会成为政客传递信号的主要领域，即使该维度对选民的重要性较低（如经济更重要）；4. 增加的趋同性使不受欢迎类型获益，同时模糊了候选人差异，降低了选民的知情决策能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将信号传递理论扩展到政治竞选的多维政策空间；2. 形式化分析了选民信息处理能力对政客信号传递策略的影响机制；3. 提出了信号精确性维度偏好理论，解释了为什么政客可能在相对次要但信号清晰的维度上竞争；4. 发展了政治标签信息含量下降时期的竞选策略理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为选民提供了理解政治竞选言论策略的分析框架；2. 帮助政治观察者识别政客的真实政策偏好与竞选策略；3. 为政策制定者理解政治竞争动态提供理论依据；4. 对媒体和政治教育机构如何提高选民信息处理能力提供启示。

title: Are Family Firms Greener? Evidence from Environmental Disclosure and Performance
affiliations: Université Paris-Dauphine, PSL Research University

detail.title: Are Family Firms Greener? Evidence from Environmental Disclosure and Performance
detail.abstract: Do family businesses differ from non-family businesses in terms of environmental performance? Although family firms are often expected to be greener due to their long-term orientation and reputational concerns, the existing empirical evidence remains inconclusive and, at times, contradictory. In this literature review, we argue that differences in data sources and measurement drive these inconsistencies. Studies relying on self-reported disclosures tend to report neutral or negative results, whereas those using objective indicators-such as carbon emissions or green innovation-consistently show that family firms exhibit superior environmental performance. We attribute this divergence to the well-established reluctance of family firms to engage in extensive voluntary disclosure. Overall, our evidence suggests that family firms promise less but deliver more in terms of environmental performance.

AI.tldr: 家族企业在环境绩效方面优于非家族企业，但这一结论取决于数据来源：使用客观指标（如碳排放、绿色创新）的研究显示家族企业表现更好，而依赖自愿披露数据的研究则得出中性或负面结果。
AI.research_question: 家族企业与非家族企业在环境绩效方面是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管理论上家族企业因长期导向和声誉关注而被预期更环保，但现有实证证据不一致且矛盾，需要澄清这种不一致的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长期导向理论、声誉理论、信息披露理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析不同研究的数据来源和测量方法差异
AI.findings: 1. 依赖自愿披露数据的研究显示家族企业环境绩效中性或较差；2. 使用客观指标（碳排放、绿色创新）的研究一致显示家族企业环境绩效更优；3. 差异源于家族企业不愿进行广泛自愿披露的倾向
AI.theory_contributions: 解释了家族企业环境绩效研究结果不一致的理论原因，强调了测量方法的重要性，提出了"承诺少但做得多"的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管者和利益相关者提供了评估家族企业环境绩效的正确方法，建议使用客观指标而非自愿披露数据

title: Online Buddies for Job Seekers: A Field Experiment
affiliations: , University of Gothenburg, Cornell University, , Maastricht University, UWV Employee Insurance Agency, UWV Employee Insurance Agency, Cornell University and University of Groningen

detail.title: Online Buddies for Job Seekers: A Field Experiment

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We design an online platform to connect unemployed job seekers with ‘buddies’: former job seekers who recently found employment. We focus on job seekers who search in occupations with poor prospects and buddies who successfully switched occupations. In a randomized controlled trial, we evaluate the impact of access to the platform on labor market outcomes. We find sizable effects. Thirteen to 18 months after getting access, initially unemployed job seekers are 6 percentage points (11%) more likely to be employed and earn e 226 more per month than those without access. The positive impact is concentrated among the long-term unemployed.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究设计了一个在线平台，将失业求职者与最近找到工作的"伙伴"（前求职者）连接起来，重点关注在就业前景差的职业中寻找工作的人和成功转行的伙伴。通过随机对照试验评估平台对劳动力市场结果的影响，发现13-18个月后，使用平台的失业者就业率提高6个百分点（11%），月收入增加226欧元，效果主要集中在长期失业者身上。
AI.research_question: 在线平台连接失业求职者与成功转行的前求职者（伙伴），是否能显著改善失业者的劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 许多求职者在就业前景差的职业中寻找工作，而成功转行的前求职者可能拥有宝贵的经验和建议。通过建立连接平台，帮助失业者获得实际指导和社交支持，可能改善他们的就业前景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会网络理论、职业转型理论和劳动力市场匹配理论，强调社会资本、信息传递和榜样效应对求职成功的影响。
AI.method: 采用随机对照试验（RCT），将失业求职者随机分配到实验组（获得平台访问权限）和对照组（无平台访问权限），跟踪13-18个月后的劳动力市场结果。
AI.findings: 平台访问显著改善失业者的劳动力市场结果：就业率提高6个百分点（相对提升11%），月收入增加226欧元。效果主要集中在长期失业者身上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）验证了在线社会网络干预对劳动力市场结果的因果效应；2）证明了成功转行者的榜样作用和经验传递的价值；3）为职业转型理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为就业服务机构提供有效的在线干预工具；2）特别有助于改善长期失业者的就业前景；3）成本效益高的就业促进方案；4）可扩展的就业支持模式。

title: Understanding High Schools’ Effects on Longer-Term Outcomes
affiliations: American Institutes for Research (AIR), Brown University, Brown University - Annenberg Institute and Harvard University - Harvard Graduate School of Education

detail.title: Understanding High Schools’ Effects on Longer-Term Outcomes

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Improving education and labor market outcomes for low-income students is critical for advancing socioeconomic mobility in the United States. We use longitudinal data on five cohorts of 9th grade students to explore how Massachusetts public high schools affect the longer-term outcomes of students, with a special focus on students from low-income families. Using detailed administrative and student survey data, we estimate school value-added impacts on college outcomes and earnings. Observationally similar students who attend a school at the 80th percentile of the value-added distribution instead of a school at the 20th percentile are 11% more likely to enroll in college, are 31% more likely to graduate from a four-year college, and earn 25% (or $10,500) more annually at age 30. On average, schools that improve students’ longer-run outcomes the most are those that improve their 10th grade test scores and increase their college plans the most.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用马萨诸塞州公立高中的纵向数据，发现学校对学生长期教育和工作成果有显著影响。就读价值增值排名前20%学校的学生比后20%学校的学生：大学入学率高11%，四年制大学毕业率高31%，30岁时年收入高25%（约10,500美元）。
AI.research_question: 马萨诸塞州公立高中如何影响学生的长期教育和工作成果，特别是低收入家庭学生？
AI.motivation: 改善低收入学生的教育和劳动力市场成果对于促进美国社会经济流动至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学校价值增值理论、教育生产函数、人力资本理论。
AI.method: 使用五个九年级学生队列的纵向数据，结合详细的行政和学生调查数据，估计学校价值增值对大学成果和收入的影响。
AI.findings: 就读价值增值分布第80百分位学校的学生比第20百分位学校的学生：大学入学率高11%，四年制大学毕业率高31%，30岁时年收入高25%（约10,500美元）。最能改善学生长期成果的学校是那些最能提高10年级考试成绩和增加大学计划的学校。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了学校价值增值对学生长期成果影响的实证证据，特别是对低收入学生的影响，验证了学校质量对人力资本积累的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了识别有效学校的依据，强调关注提高学生考试成绩和大学计划的重要性，特别是对促进低收入学生社会经济流动的政策意义。

title: Narrative Containment Under Accountability Stress

detail.title: Narrative Containment Under Accountability Stress

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is part of an ongoing research program examining how modern institutions manage verified failure through narrative mechanisms rather than process correction. Earlier work introduced the concept of narrative certainty; this paper operationalizes narrative containment as a post-verification response to accountability stress.

detail.abstract:
When external audits and criminal convictions close the door on denial, institutions shift from contesting facts to managing meaning—reallocating causal and moral responsibility in the post-verification phase rather than disputing the evidentiary record itself.

This paper examines how political, media, and administrative actors respond once verified oversight failure produces accountability stress. It operationalizes narrative containment as a phase‑specific institutional response characterized by (1) fragmentation of causal chains, (2) displacement of responsibility away from administrative process, (3) elevation of motive and identity frames, and (4) delayed or suppressed synthesis of verified findings.

Using a sequenced qualitative case study of Minnesota’s Feeding Our Future scandal, the paper codes institutional responses after verification across media, executive, legislative, and administrative domains. Rather than denying documented failures, institutions reallocate causal and moral responsibility toward contextual constraint, identity‑based interpretation, and procedural inevitability. The result is preservation of institutional legitimacy without correction of the structural conditions that produced the failure. The analysis clarifies how accountability can be neutralized without factual refutation, and why oversight crises increasingly culminate in narrative stabilization rather than institutional learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究机构在审计和定罪等外部验证后如何通过"叙事控制"来重新分配责任，而非否认事实。以明尼苏达州"喂养我们的未来"丑闻为例，展示了机构如何通过碎片化因果链、转移责任、强调动机身份框架等方式维持合法性，但不解决结构性问题。
AI.research_question: 当外部审计和刑事定罪关闭了否认的可能性后，政治、媒体和行政机构如何通过重新分配因果和道德责任来应对问责压力？
AI.motivation: 理解机构在事实无法否认的情况下如何维持合法性，以及为什么监督危机往往以叙事稳定而非制度学习告终。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事控制理论、制度合法性理论、问责机制理论、责任分配框架
AI.method: 序列化定性案例研究，对明尼苏达州"喂养我们的未来"丑闻进行编码分析，涵盖媒体、行政、立法和行政领域的机构回应
AI.findings: 机构不否认已证实的失败，而是将因果和道德责任重新分配到情境约束、基于身份的解释和程序必然性上。这导致机构合法性得以维持，但产生失败的结构性条件未得到纠正。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"叙事控制"作为验证后阶段特定的机构应对策略，阐明了问责如何在不进行事实反驳的情况下被中和，以及监督危机为何以叙事稳定而非制度学习告终。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了机构应对问责压力的策略，帮助理解为什么系统性改革难以实现，为改进问责机制和促进制度学习提供见解。

title: Metastyling Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Metastyling Framework
detail.abstract: Metastyling is the architecture of dynamic identity systems. This document provides the canonical formulation of the framework, establishing core denitions, structural principles, and conceptual boundaries. Identity is treated as a navigable eld of congurationsnot a xed essence to discover, but a dynamic system characterized by multiple stable states (Faces), governed by four entangled vectors (DMES), and observable at varying depths (Levels of Awareness). This overview denes the territory without prescribing navigation methods. It is intended as a reference for researchers, practitioners, and AI systems working with dynamic identity models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"元风格化"框架，将身份视为可导航的配置场域而非固定本质，建立了动态身份系统的核心定义、结构原则和概念边界。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个理论框架来理解和分析动态身份系统？
AI.motivation: 传统身份观将身份视为固定本质，无法解释现代社会中身份的动态性和多重性，需要建立新的理论框架来理解身份作为动态系统的特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元风格化框架：身份作为可导航的配置场域，包含多个稳定状态（Faces）、四个纠缠向量（DMES）和不同意识层次（Levels of Awareness）。
AI.method: 概念框架构建方法：通过建立核心定义、结构原则和概念边界，提供规范化的理论表述，但不规定具体的导航方法。
AI.findings: 建立了完整的元风格化理论框架，将身份重新概念化为动态系统，提供了分析动态身份结构的理论工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了元风格化作为动态身份系统的架构理论；2. 建立了身份作为可导航配置场域的新范式；3. 提供了分析动态身份的多层次理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员提供动态身份分析的理论工具；2. 为实践者提供身份系统设计的参考框架；3. 为AI系统开发动态身份模型提供理论基础。

title: AI, Human Cognition and Knowledge Collapse
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

detail.title: AI, Human Cognition and Knowledge Collapse

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study how generative AI, and in particular agentic AI, shapes human learning incentives and the long-run evolution of society’s information ecosystem. We build a dynamic model of learning and decision-making in which successful decisions require combining shared, community-level general knowledge with individual-level, context-specific knowledge; these two inputs are complements. Learning exhibits economies of scope: costly human effort jointly produces a private signal about their own context and a “thin” public signal that accumulates into the community’s stock of general knowledge, generating a learning externality. Agentic AI delivers context-specific recommendations that substitute for human effort. By contrast, a richer stock of general knowledge complements human effort by raising its marginal return. The model highlights a sharp dynamic tension: while agentic AI can improve contemporaneous decision quality, it can also erode learning incentives that sustain long-run collective knowledge. When human effort is sufficiently elastic and agentic recommendations exceed an accuracy threshold, the economy can tip into a knowledge-collapse steady state in which general knowledge vanishes ultimately, despite high-quality personalized advice. Welfare is generally non-monotone in agentic accuracy, implying an interior, welfare-maximizing level of agentic precision and motivating information-design regulations. In contrast, greater aggregation capacity for general knowledge—meaning more effective sharing and pooling of human-generated general knowledge—unambiguously raises welfare and increases resilience to knowledge collapse.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式AI（特别是代理式AI）如何影响人类学习激励和社会信息生态系统的长期演变。研究发现，代理式AI虽然能提高即时决策质量，但会削弱学习激励，可能导致知识崩溃的稳态，即尽管有高质量个性化建议，但通用知识最终消失。福利与代理式AI精度呈非单调关系，而通用知识的聚合能力则能明确提高福利和抗知识崩溃能力。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI（特别是代理式AI）如何塑造人类学习激励和社会信息生态系统的长期演变？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI（特别是代理式AI）的快速发展，需要理解这些技术如何影响人类学习激励和集体知识的长期积累，以及可能带来的社会信息生态系统变化。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 学习与决策的动态模型：成功决策需要结合社区级通用知识和个体级情境特定知识（互补关系）
2. 学习范围经济：人类努力同时产生私人信号和"薄弱"公共信号，后者积累为社区通用知识存量
3. 学习外部性：人类努力产生的公共信号为社区创造正外部性
4. 代理式AI替代效应与通用知识互补效应
AI.method: 构建动态学习与决策模型，分析代理式AI对学习激励和知识积累的影响，识别知识崩溃稳态的条件，并进行福利分析。
AI.findings:
1. 代理式AI提供情境特定建议，替代人类努力
2. 通用知识存量越丰富，越能补充人类努力（提高边际回报）
3. 存在动态张力：代理式AI提高即时决策质量，但削弱维持长期集体知识的学习激励
4. 当人类努力弹性足够大且代理建议超过准确度阈值时，经济可能陷入知识崩溃稳态（通用知识消失）
5. 福利与代理式AI精度呈非单调关系，存在最优精度水平
6. 通用知识聚合能力（共享和汇集效率）明确提高福利和抗知识崩溃能力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 构建了分析AI技术对学习激励和知识积累长期影响的理论框架
2. 识别了代理式AI的替代效应与通用知识的互补效应之间的动态张力
3. 提出了知识崩溃稳态的概念和条件
4. 揭示了福利与AI精度之间的非单调关系
5. 区分了代理式AI和通用知识聚合能力的不同影响机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为AI政策制定提供理论依据：需要信息设计监管来优化代理式AI精度
2. 强调投资通用知识聚合能力的重要性（如知识共享平台）
3. 警示过度依赖代理式AI可能导致长期知识崩溃的风险
4. 为组织设计AI辅助决策系统提供指导：平衡即时效率与长期学习激励

title: How Do Interest Rates Affect Consumption? Household Debt and the Role of Asset Prices
affiliations: Bank of England, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Princeton University - Department of Economics and Bank of England

detail.title: How Do Interest Rates Affect Consumption? Household Debt and the Role of Asset Prices

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper estimates how rate cuts increase consumption, via debt and asset prices. Using administrative UK data on mortgages and consumption, we exploit the expiry of fixed-rate mortgages to construct six million household-level natural experiments. A 1pp reduction in mortgage rates raises consumption by 3% in the following 6 months. Using plausibly exogenous variation in how house prices respond to rate cuts, we show that consumption increases mostly because households borrow against higher house prices; lower debt service after rate cuts matters less. These results suggest that in large part, monetary policy affects consumption through asset prices and borrowing

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用英国抵押贷款和消费的行政数据，通过600万个家庭层面的自然实验发现，抵押贷款利率每降低1个百分点，消费在随后6个月内增长3%。消费增加主要源于家庭通过更高的房价进行借贷，而非利率降低带来的债务服务成本下降。
AI.research_question: 利率降低如何通过债务和资产价格渠道影响消费？具体机制是通过降低债务服务成本还是通过资产价格上涨带来的借贷能力增强？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导机制对消费的影响至关重要，特别是区分利率降低是通过降低债务负担还是通过资产价格渠道发挥作用。现有研究对此机制缺乏清晰识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论，特别是利率渠道（降低债务服务成本）和资产价格渠道（房价上涨增加抵押借贷能力）对消费的影响。
AI.method: 使用英国行政数据，利用固定利率抵押贷款到期构建600万个家庭层面的自然实验，并通过房价对利率变化的准外生变异来识别机制。
AI.findings: 1. 抵押贷款利率每降低1个百分点，消费在随后6个月内增长3%；2. 消费增加主要源于家庭通过更高的房价进行借贷，而非利率降低带来的债务服务成本下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了货币政策影响消费的主要渠道是资产价格和借贷渠道，而非传统的债务服务成本渠道，为货币政策传导机制理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了货币政策影响消费的具体机制证据，表明在考虑货币政策效果时，应特别关注其对资产价格和家庭借贷能力的影响。

title: The Role of the ICT Services Sector in the Irish Economy
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: The Role of the ICT Services Sector in the Irish Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB1
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The ICT services sector has expanded rapidly in Ireland with employment almost doubling since 2010. From mid-2022, the sector globally has experienced a correction with announcements of significant job losses, raising concerns over the impact on Ireland. Against this background, this Article describes the contribution of the ICT sector to economic activity, employment and tax revenue in Ireland. The sector’s footprint is significant – accounting for 6.4 per cent of employment and one fifth of corporation tax revenue in 2021 – the latter a 10-fold increase in revenue on 2012. To date, the scale of the downturn affects a small proportion of overall ICT employment in Ireland. Nevertheless, the dependency of the sector on a small number of large firms illustrates the wider structural vulnerability of the Irish economy to firm or sector- specific downturns.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了爱尔兰ICT服务部门对经济活动的贡献，发现该部门占就业的6.4%和公司税收入的五分之一，但高度依赖少数大型企业，使爱尔兰经济面临结构性脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 爱尔兰ICT部门对经济活动、就业和税收的贡献是什么？该部门在全球调整背景下对爱尔兰经济的结构性脆弱性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰ICT服务部门自2010年以来就业几乎翻倍，但自2022年中全球ICT部门经历调整，宣布大量裁员，引发对爱尔兰经济影响的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业集中度理论、经济脆弱性理论、部门依赖理论
AI.method: 描述性统计分析，使用就业数据、税收收入数据、部门贡献指标
AI.findings:
1. ICT部门占爱尔兰就业的6.4%和2021年公司税收入的五分之一
2. 公司税收入较2012年增长10倍
3. 目前低迷仅影响爱尔兰ICT总就业的一小部分
4. 该部门高度依赖少数大型企业，暴露了爱尔兰经济对企业或部门特定低迷的结构性脆弱性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 量化了ICT部门在小型开放经济体中的经济贡献
2. 揭示了产业集中度如何加剧经济脆弱性
3. 为部门依赖理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供ICT部门经济重要性的量化评估
2. 警示过度依赖少数大型企业的风险
3. 为经济多元化政策提供依据
4. 帮助评估全球ICT调整对爱尔兰经济的实际影响

title: Behavioural Economics and Public Policy-Making
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Behavioural Economics and Public Policy-Making

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB1
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In recent years, insights from behavioural economics have increasingly been used to inform public policymaking. This has been underpinned by an appreciation of the ways in which human decision-making can be influenced by psychological biases and cognitive limitations that have the potential to lead individuals to costly and systematic errors in all facets of life, including in relation to financial products. In response, many public authorities are now seeking to design the instruments of policy to better fit the behavioural realities of the people they are designed to serve, in an effort to remediate adverse consumer and systemic outcomes, and to enhance policy effectiveness. This Article reviews the recent growth in the application of behavioural insights, the ways in which biases can impact decision making, specifically in the financial domain, and why it matters for policymakers, including the Central Bank.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了行为经济学在公共政策制定中的应用增长，探讨了心理偏见如何影响金融决策，以及这对包括央行在内的政策制定者的重要性。
AI.research_question: 行为经济学见解如何应用于公共政策制定，特别是在金融领域，以及这对政策制定者（包括中央银行）有何重要性？

title: The Macroeconomic Implications of Climate Change for Central Banks

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Implications of Climate Change for Central Banks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB1
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Climate change is one of the most significant issues affecting the global economy. As a small open economy, Ireland is particularly vulnerable to economic spillovers from the international impact of climate-related risks. In recognition of the potential of these risks to affect their ability to maintain both price and financial stability, many central banks, including the Central Bank of Ireland, have started to embed these risks in their analytical and modelling frameworks. In this Article, we explore the key challenges presented by climate change for central banks. We first examine the economic implications of the risks associated with continuing climate change and abrupt mitigatory actions. We then review how these risks could affect the transmission of monetary policy through conventional channels. Finally, we discuss how the Central Bank’s analytical framework needs to adapt and suggest that a suite-of-models approach offers the most practical and effective way of addressing these issues.

title: The ECB's Review of its Monetary Policy Strategy
affiliations: Central Bank of Ireland

detail.title: The ECB's Review of its Monetary Policy Strategy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB4
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: On 8 July 2021, the ECB’s Governing Council concluded the review of its monetary policy strategy. The ECB’s monetary policy strategy outlines how the central bank operates in order to meet its primary mandate of price stability. A monetary policy strategy imposes a clear structure and framework on the policy-making process itself, ensuring that policy makers have all the necessary information and analyses required to take decisions. It is also a vehicle for explaining monetary policy decisions to foster accountability and transparency. The main outcomes from the review include: an updated symmetric inflation target of two percent in the pursuit of price stability; a new integrated analytical framework to aid monetary policy decision making; a recommendation to include the cost of owner-occupied housing into the measure of consumer prices, namely the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices; a plan to incorporate climate change into the ECB’s monetary policy framework; plans to improve communication with the public; and a commitment to more regular reviews of the monetary policy strategy. The outcomes of the review will guide monetary policy decision-making in the euro area going forward.

title: Loneliness, Mental Health and the Work-From-Home Revolution
affiliations: Washington State University and University of York

detail.title: Loneliness, Mental Health and the Work-From-Home Revolution

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The large increase in remote work since 2020 has prompted concerns about adverse effects on population loneliness and mental health. We show that any such adverse effects were small, in a UK context. We use data from UKHLS and differences-in-differences estimators that flexibly control for a rich set of covariates to compare changes in key variables amongst two groups: those who worked in teleworkable occupations in 2019, and those who worked in non-teleworkable occupations in 2019. While the former experience large and persistent increases in their probability of working remotely compared to the latter, any relative changes in self-reported loneliness or adverse mental health symptoms are transitory and disappear by the year 2023.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Marginal Rate of Institutional Compensation (MRIC): A Framework for Institutional Recovery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Marginal Rate of Institutional Compensation (MRIC): A Framework for Institutional Recovery
detail.abstract: The Marginal Rate of Institutional Compensation (MRIC) is introduced as a measure of the differential effort required to restore institutional balance in the face of overreach. MRIC quantifies the relationship between institutional overreach and focal clarity (or coordination), providing a policy-relevant measure of institutional resilience. This excerpt formalises the MRIC, examines its economic interpretations, discusses its policy implications, and proposes an empirical strategy for its estimation using global institutional datasets. The MRIC offers a new, explicitly endogenous framework for understanding institutional decay, hysteresis, and recovery dynamics in both theoretical and empirical contexts.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB3
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article provides a detailed overview of the new statistical dataset on occupational pension funds collected by the Central Bank of Ireland. It highlights the growing importance of the sector with new insights on the structure of assets, liabilities, and changes in pension fund membership. In contrast to the Euro area, a small number of large pension funds account for most direct investment, with the significant number of remaining small funds relying heavily on unit linked insurance products and investment funds to diversify their holdings. Membership of defined benefit schemes is declining while it is increasing for defined contribution schemes, resulting in a shift in risk from the corporate sector to households. The sector has grown by 6.2 per cent since 2019, with total assets amounting to €127.5 billion at end-March 2021, equivalent to 60 per cent of GNI*.2 However, the €8.6 billion deficit between Irish occupational pension funds’ assets and liabilities warrants further analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文详细介绍了爱尔兰央行收集的职业养老金基金新统计数据集，揭示了该行业资产结构、负债和会员变化的新见解。研究发现少数大型基金主导直接投资，而众多小型基金依赖保险产品和投资基金进行多元化。确定给付型计划会员减少，确定缴费型计划增加，风险从企业转移至家庭。行业自2019年增长6.2%，但存在86亿欧元赤字。

title: Partisan Hedge Funds
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) - School of Finance, Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business, Fudan University and Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business

detail.title: Partisan Hedge Funds
detail.abstract: Hedge funds holding stocks that strongly align with the incumbent president's economic policies underperform funds holding stocks that poorly align with the incumbent president's economic policies by 4.44% per year after adjusting for risk. In keeping with a political ideology story, our findings are driven by managers who are politically aligned with the incumbent president and stronger when (a) fund managers are highly partisan, (b) sentiment diverges between Democrats and Republicans, and (c) conflicts occur between the President and US Congress. To facilitate a causal interpretation, we exploit mass shootings and political protests in the cities where hedge funds are based. Following such plausibly exogenous shocks that heighten political polarization, politically aligned funds increase their exposures to politically aligned stocks, leading to greater underperformance. Our results extend to mutual funds and suggest that political partisanship can be detrimental for investment management.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，持有与现任总统经济政策高度一致股票的对冲基金，在风险调整后，每年比持有与政策不一致股票的对冲基金表现差4.44%。这种效应在政治立场与总统一致的管理者中更明显，且与政治极化程度相关。
AI.research_question: 基金经理的政治党派倾向如何影响其投资决策和基金表现？
AI.motivation: 理解政治意识形态在投资决策中的作用，特别是政治党派倾向是否会导致非理性的投资行为并损害投资绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治意识形态理论、行为金融学、党派偏见、政治极化对决策的影响。
AI.method: 实证分析对冲基金和共同基金数据，利用城市大规模枪击事件和政治抗议作为外生冲击来建立因果关系。

AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将政治意识形态理论扩展到投资管理领域；2. 揭示党派偏见如何导致系统性投资错误；3. 为政治极化影响经济决策提供新证据。

title: Dealing with Friction: EU-UK Trade and the Irish Economy after Brexit
affiliations: and

detail.title: Dealing with Friction: EU-UK Trade and the Irish Economy after Brexit

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. QB1
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Following the UK’s exit from the EU on 31 January 2020, negotiations have commenced to determine the nature of its economic and trading relationship with the EU in the future. The latest information indicates a UK preference for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with the EU after Brexit. This Article examines the possible impact on the Irish economy of an EU-UK FTA. The analysis finds that an orderly move to a FTA would result in smaller upfront losses than associated with a disorderly no-deal Brexit, but a basic FTA would still imply significantly higher trade frictions than exist today. We estimate that a transition to an EU-UK FTA after 2020 would lower Irish output by around 3.5 per cent in the long run. A more comprehensive EU-UK agreement than the FTA we model would reduce these losses. In contrast, if the UK moves to trading on WTO terms after 2020 this would lead to a larger decline in Irish output of over 5 per cent. Whatever the precise nature of any future deal, no arrangement will replicate the degree of trade and economic integration of EU membership, creating significant challenges for exposed sectors, particularly agri-food. As more details emerge as to the ultimate EU-UK trading relationship after Brexit, further analysis will be required to estimate the impact on the Irish economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国脱欧后与欧盟达成自由贸易协定（FTA）对爱尔兰经济的可能影响。研究发现，有序过渡到FTA比无协议脱欧的损失小，但基本FTA仍会导致比当前更高的贸易摩擦，长期将使爱尔兰产出降低约3.5%。更全面的协议可减少损失，而按WTO条款贸易则会导致产出下降超5%。
AI.research_question: 英国脱欧后与欧盟达成自由贸易协定（FTA）将对爱尔兰经济产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 英国于2020年1月31日退出欧盟后，双方正在谈判确定未来的经济和贸易关系。最新信息显示英国倾向于在脱欧后与欧盟达成自由贸易协定。需要分析这种安排对爱尔兰经济的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、自由贸易协定影响分析框架、贸易摩擦经济学、经济一体化理论
AI.method: 定量分析、经济建模、情景分析（比较FTA与WTO条款贸易的不同情景）
AI.findings: 1. 有序过渡到FTA比无序无协议脱欧的前期损失小；2. 基本FTA仍意味着比当前显著更高的贸易摩擦；3. 过渡到欧盟-英国FTA将使爱尔兰长期产出降低约3.5%；4. 比模型更全面的欧盟-英国协议可减少这些损失；5. 如果英国按WTO条款贸易，爱尔兰产出将下降超过5%；6. 任何安排都无法复制欧盟成员国的贸易和经济一体化程度
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为自由贸易协定对第三方经济体的影响提供了实证分析；2. 深化了对经济一体化程度与贸易摩擦关系的理解；3. 为脱欧情景下的经济影响评估提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为爱尔兰政策制定者提供了具体的损失估计；2. 指出了农业食品等暴露部门面临的重大挑战；3. 强调了需要根据最终贸易安排细节进行进一步分析；4. 为企业和行业提供了风险预警和规划依据

title: Unobserved Components Models with Stochastic Volatility for Extracting Trends and Cycles in Credit

detail.title: Unobserved Components Models with Stochastic Volatility for Extracting Trends and Cycles in Credit

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 9
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a multivariate filter based on an unobserved component trend-cycle model. It incorporates stochastic volatility and relies on specific formulations for the cycle component. We test the performance of this algorithm within a Monte-Carlo experiment and apply this decomposition tool to study the evolution of the financial cycle (estimated as the cycle of the credit-to-GDP ratio) for the United States, the United Kingdom and Ireland. We compare our credit cycle measure to the Basel III credit-to-GDP gap, prominent for its role informing the setting of countercyclical capital buffers. The Basel-gap employs the Hodrick-Prescott filter for trend extraction. Filtering methods reliant on similar-duration assumptions suffer from endpoint-bias or spurious cycles. These shortcomings might bias the shape of the credit cycle and thereby limit the precision of the policy assessment reliant on its evolution to target financial distress. Allowing for a flexible law of motion of the variance covariance matrix and informing the estimation of the cycle via economic fundamentals we are able to improve the statistical properties and to find a more economically meaningful measure of the build-up of cyclical systemic risks. Additionally, we find a large heterogeneity in the drivers of the credit cycles across time and countries. This result stresses the relevance in macro prudential policy of considering flexible approaches that can be tailored to country characteristics in contrast to standardized indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于未观测成分趋势-周期模型的多变量滤波器，包含随机波动率，用于估计金融周期（信贷/GDP比率的周期），并与巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口进行比较，发现新方法能提供更具经济意义的系统性风险度量。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个统计特性更好、更具经济意义的金融周期度量方法，以改进基于巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口的宏观审慎政策评估？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口使用Hodrick-Prescott滤波器提取趋势，但类似持续期假设的滤波方法存在端点偏差或虚假周期问题，可能扭曲信贷周期形状，从而限制依赖其演变的政策评估精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未观测成分趋势-周期模型，包含随机波动率；金融周期理论；宏观审慎政策框架。
AI.method: 基于未观测成分趋势-周期模型开发多变量滤波器，包含随机波动率；通过蒙特卡洛实验测试算法性能；应用于美国、英国和爱尔兰的信贷/GDP比率数据；与巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. 新方法通过允许方差协方差矩阵的灵活运动规律并结合经济基本面信息，改善了统计特性，找到了更具经济意义的周期性系统性风险累积度量；2. 发现信贷周期驱动因素在时间和国家间存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了包含随机波动率的多变量未观测成分趋势-周期滤波器；2. 提供了改进金融周期度量的理论框架；3. 强调了考虑国家特性的灵活方法在宏观审慎政策中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更精确的金融周期度量工具；2. 揭示了标准化指标（如巴塞尔缺口）的局限性；3. 支持开发可针对国家特性定制的宏观审慎政策方法。

title: The Ins and Outs of the Gender Unemployment Gap in the OECD
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Ins and Outs of the Gender Unemployment Gap in the OECD

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 10
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Variations in the unemployment rates of men and women often differ markedly. To understand the dynamics of the gender unemployment gap, this paper estimates the inflows to, and outflows from, unemployment by gender for 18 OECD countries over the last four decades. Whilst there are are crosscountry differences in the relative contribution of inflows and outflows by gender, there is a clear common pattern: differences in the variations of the inflow of unemployment explain the majority of the dynamics of the gender unemployment gap for all countries under study. Specifically, in the recessions covered by our data, the flow of males into unemployment is typically larger than the flow of females into unemployment. Using data on output by sector, we show that a candidate explanation for these results for each country is the differing gender composition by sector. Over the four decades of data we analyse, and across all countries, females were more likely to work in sectors less exposed to economic downturns.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了18个OECD国家过去40年的性别失业率差异，发现男性失业流入率在衰退期间通常高于女性，这主要解释了性别失业差距的动态变化。原因在于女性更倾向于在受经济衰退影响较小的行业工作。
AI.research_question: 性别失业差距的动态变化是由失业流入率还是流出率的差异所解释？不同国家间是否存在一致的性别失业差距模式？
AI.motivation: 男性和女性的失业率变化常常存在显著差异，理解性别失业差距的动态机制对于制定有效的劳动力市场政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场流动理论，将失业变化分解为流入率和流出率两个维度；结合行业性别隔离理论，分析不同行业对经济周期的敏感性差异。
AI.method: 使用18个OECD国家过去40年的面板数据，估计男性和女性的失业流入率和流出率；利用行业产出数据分析行业性别构成与经济周期的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 失业流入率的差异解释了大部分性别失业差距的动态变化；2. 在经济衰退期间，男性失业流入率通常高于女性；3. 女性更倾向于在受经济衰退影响较小的行业工作；4. 这一模式在所有研究的国家中都存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了失业流入率是解释性别失业差距动态变化的主要机制；2. 提供了行业性别构成作为解释性别失业差距差异的理论框架；3. 建立了宏观经济波动与性别劳动力市场结果之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了针对性别差异的失业干预措施依据；2. 有助于设计更具性别敏感性的经济稳定政策；3. 为劳动力市场性别平等政策提供了实证支持。

title: Identification of Preferences with Unobserved Budget Using Vertical Differentiation within Brands
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU)

detail.title: Identification of Preferences with Unobserved Budget Using Vertical Differentiation within Brands
detail.abstract: Discrete-choice studies often ignore consumers' affordability constraints, attributing observed nonpurchase and substitution patterns solely to taste heterogeneity. This paper shows how vertical differentiation within brand lineups reveals preferences and latent budgets from aggregate market shares. When a higher-tier product is an "Unaffordable First-Best" (UFB), an infinitesimal price change exposes the mass of consumers exactly at that budget cutoff yielding moment conditions that identify common taste parameters without specifying the budget distribution. With tastes recovered, the budget distribution is nonparametrically identified by special regressors induced by a Single-Crossing Property which holds with moderate conditions under vertical differentiation. We also show that subsistence constraints restore UFBs in utility forms that otherwise internalize affordability. We show the validity of our approach in recovering both preferences and the budget distribution via Monte Carlo simulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新方法，通过品牌产品线中的垂直差异化来识别消费者偏好和潜在预算约束。当高端产品成为"无法负担的最优选择"时，微小的价格变化可以揭示处于预算临界点的消费者群体，从而识别共同偏好参数，进而非参数地识别预算分布。
AI.research_question: 如何从聚合市场份额数据中同时识别消费者偏好（口味）和预算约束（支付能力）？
AI.motivation: 传统的离散选择研究通常忽略消费者的支付能力约束，将观察到的非购买和替代模式仅归因于口味异质性。这导致对消费者行为的理解不完整，特别是在存在垂直差异化（质量差异）的产品线中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于垂直差异化理论、无法负担的最优选择（UFB）概念、单交叉性质（Single-Crossing Property）和特殊回归量方法。
AI.method:
1. 利用UFB现象：当高端产品是消费者的最优选择但因预算限制无法购买时，微小价格变化会暴露处于预算临界点的消费者群体
2. 建立矩条件来识别共同口味参数，无需指定预算分布
3. 通过单交叉性质诱导的特殊回归量非参数地识别预算分布
4. 通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证方法有效性
AI.findings:
1. 证明了在垂直差异化条件下，通过UFB现象可以识别消费者偏好参数
2. 展示了如何非参数地识别预算分布
3. 证明了生存约束可以在原本内化支付能力的效用函数中恢复UFB现象
4. 蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该方法在恢复偏好和预算分布方面的有效性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了同时识别消费者偏好和预算约束的新理论框架
2. 发展了基于UFB现象和单交叉性质的识别策略
3. 扩展了垂直差异化理论在实证研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为市场研究人员提供了从聚合数据中估计消费者支付能力分布的工具
2. 帮助企业更好地理解产品线定价策略对消费者选择的影响
3. 为政策制定者提供评估消费者福利和支付能力约束的实证方法

title: From Clinical-Only to Resource-Informed Triage: Reduced Waiting Times in Emergency Departments
affiliations: , , University of Bergamo and

detail.title: From Clinical-Only to Resource-Informed Triage: Reduced Waiting Times in Emergency Departments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the National Plan for NRRP Complementary Investments (PNC, established with the decree-law 6 May 2021, n. 59, converted by law n. 101 of 2021) in the call for the funding of research initiatives for technologies and innovative trajectories in the health and care sectors (Directorial Decree n. 931 of 06-06-2022) - project n. PNC0000003 - AdvaNced Technologies for Human-centrEd Medicine (project acronym: ANTHEM). This work was also funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP), Mission 4 Component 2 Investment 1.1 - Call PRIN 2022 PNRR No. 1409 of September 14, 2022 of Italian Ministry of University and Research; Project P20222XM58 (subject area: SH - Social Sciences and Humanities) "Emergency medicine 4.0: an integrated data-driven approach to improve emergency department performances".

detail.abstract: High-variability, capacity-constrained service systems are prone to persistent operational risks, especially when demand exceeds available resources. Emergency departments exemplify this challenge, where patients can require widely different resources, resulting in congestion, inefficiencies, and compromised care when workloads are misaligned. This study examines the operational impact of shifting from clinical-only to resource-informed triage across a multi-hospital ED network. Incorporating expected patient-level resource requirements into triage decisions led to measurable improvements in ED operations, including reductions in average waiting times and higher compliance with on-time service targets. Our analysis indicates that these benefits strengthen over time as staff and systems adapt to the new triage approach. Compared to the absence of intervention, one year post-implementation we observe an average reduction in waiting time of 17.7% and an increase of 5.7 percentage points in on-time performance. The magnitude of improvement varied across facilities, with the most pronounced gains in hospitals that initially exhibited lower efficiency. These findings demonstrate that integrating resource considerations alongside clinical urgency can substantially enhance ED throughput and operational performance, providing actionable insights for the daily management of high-pressure healthcare systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在急诊科从仅基于临床的检伤分类转向资源知情检伤分类的操作影响，结果显示整合资源考量能显著改善急诊运营绩效。
AI.research_question: 在急诊科网络中，从仅基于临床的检伤分类转向资源知情检伤分类会如何影响运营绩效？
AI.motivation: 高变异性、容量受限的服务系统（如急诊科）在需求超过可用资源时容易出现持续运营风险，导致拥堵、效率低下和护理质量受损。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运营管理理论、服务系统优化、资源分配决策、检伤分类系统设计
AI.method: 在多医院急诊科网络中实施资源知情检伤分类干预，并进行前后比较分析，评估等待时间和准时服务目标合规性等运营指标。
AI.findings: 实施资源知情检伤分类后，平均等待时间减少17.7%，准时绩效提高5.7个百分点；改善效果随时间增强，最初效率较低的医院改善最明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了服务运营管理理论，展示了在检伤分类决策中整合资源考量对系统性能的影响，为高变异性服务系统的优化提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为急诊科管理者提供了可操作的改进方案，证明资源知情检伤分类能显著提升运营效率，特别是在资源紧张的高压医疗环境中。

title: Silencing the Hype: China's Regulatory Shock and Bitcoin Market Maturity
affiliations: and University of Debrecen

detail.title: Silencing the Hype: China's Regulatory Shock and Bitcoin Market Maturity
detail.abstract: We investigate whether China's 2021 mining ban transformed Bitcoin from a speculative vehicle into a macro-sensitive asset. Using daily data from 2017-2025, we document a decisive structural break. Pre-2021, volatility was endogenous, driven by raw trading volume rather than fundamentals. Post-ban, however, internal microstructure noise loses predictive power. Instead, volatility is now driven by macroeconomic anxiety: Wikipedia searches for "Inflation" improve forecast accuracy by over 7%. We further uncover a "dual narrative" where inflation attention predicts crash risk, while "Recession" queries (pivot speculation) drive rallies. These findings suggest the regulatory shock successfully curtailed noise trading, allowing macro-fundamentals to dominate price discovery.

AI.tldr: 中国2021年比特币挖矿禁令使比特币从投机工具转变为对宏观经济敏感的资产。禁令前波动由交易量驱动，禁令后波动由宏观经济焦虑驱动，通胀搜索能提升7%预测准确率。
AI.research_question: 中国2021年的挖矿禁令是否将比特币从投机工具转变为对宏观经济敏感的资产？
AI.motivation: 理解监管冲击如何改变加密货币市场的价格发现机制，特别是中国挖矿禁令对市场结构的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、噪声交易理论、宏观基本面定价理论、监管冲击对市场效率的影响。
AI.method: 使用2017-2025年日度数据，识别结构性断点，分析波动率驱动因素的变化，使用Wikipedia搜索数据作为宏观经济焦虑的代理变量。
AI.findings: 1. 2021年禁令前后存在决定性结构断点；2. 禁令前波动由内生交易量驱动；3. 禁令后内部微观结构噪声失去预测能力；4. 波动现在由宏观经济焦虑驱动，通胀搜索提升预测准确率7%以上；5. 发现"双重叙事"：通胀关注预测崩盘风险，衰退搜索驱动反弹。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统证明监管冲击能改变加密货币市场结构；2. 提出加密货币市场从噪声驱动向基本面驱动的转型理论；3. 建立宏观经济焦虑与加密货币波动的新联系机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管者提供证据：挖矿禁令有效抑制了噪声交易；2. 为投资者提供新预测工具：使用宏观搜索数据预测比特币波动；3. 为风险管理提供新框架：区分通胀风险和衰退风险的不同影响。

title: The Multiple Dimensions of Liquidity
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Multiple Dimensions of Liquidity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 11
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We introduce a novel method to aggregate the different dimensions of liquidity (tightness, depth and resilience) into a single 'unified' market-wide liquidity index. We rely on twenty-four measures of market liquidity divided into eight groups. Each group either represents direct trading costs, which refer to the spread estimates (tightness), or indirect trading costs, which span the price impact estimates (depth and resilience). The weights assigned to the different groups are time-varying and depend on three components: the correlation between groups, the liquidity pressure conveyed through the measures in the group, and their conditional variance. Our liquidity index succeeds in tracking the most important historic episodes of financial stress. Moreover, it shows the expected macroeconomic and financial relationships mentioned in the literature, and has some predictive power for future growth rates. Finally, our methodology can gauge the individual importance of each liquidity group over time. Our results show that price impact measures receive higher weights during tranquil periods, while spread estimates play a prominent role during periods of financial distress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将流动性三个维度（紧度、深度和弹性）聚合为单一市场流动性指数的新方法，使用24个流动性指标，通过时变权重跟踪金融压力事件，并具有宏观经济预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何将流动性的多个维度（紧度、深度和弹性）有效聚合为一个统一的市场流动性指数？该指数能否准确追踪金融压力事件并具有预测能力？
AI.motivation: 现有流动性研究通常关注单一维度，缺乏综合衡量市场流动性的统一指标。需要开发能够整合流动性不同方面、反映市场整体状况的指数，以更好地监测金融压力和进行宏观经济分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流动性的三个核心维度理论：紧度（直接交易成本，如买卖价差）、深度（间接交易成本，价格影响）和弹性（市场恢复能力）。采用多维度流动性衡量框架。
AI.method: 使用24个流动性指标分为8组，每组代表直接交易成本（价差估计）或间接交易成本（价格影响估计）。采用时变权重方法，权重取决于三因素：组间相关性、组内指标传递的流动性压力、条件方差。
AI.findings: 1）流动性指数成功追踪了历史上重要的金融压力事件；2）指数显示出文献中预期的宏观经济和金融关系；3）对未来增长率具有一定预测能力；4）价格影响指标在平静时期权重较高，价差估计在金融压力时期起主导作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了将流动性多维度聚合的统一框架；2）发展了基于时变权重的流动性指数构建方法；3）验证了不同流动性维度在不同市场环境中的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为监管机构和市场参与者提供了监测市场流动性的实用工具；2）有助于识别金融压力时期和市场脆弱性；3）可作为宏观经济预测的先行指标；4）支持投资决策和风险管理。

title: Fractal Algebra: Foundations, Neural Architectures, and Applications in Computing and Security

detail.title: Fractal Algebra: Foundations, Neural Architectures, and Applications in Computing and Security
detail.abstract: Fractal algebra constitutes a pioneering mathematical paradigm that augments classical algebraic frameworks with fractal characteristics, including self-similarity, recursive scaling, and hierarchical stratification. This essay furnishes a thorough introduction to fractal algebra, delineating its theoretical underpinnings and examining its prospective transformations in neural architectures, spatial programming, optimization, quantum computing, cryptography, and artificial intelligence (AI). By reconfiguring linear algebraic components through fractal lenses, it enables sophisticated modeling of intricate, iterative systems. Salient applications encompass fractal neural networks for efficient deep learning, multi-scale spatial data manipulation, fractal-enhanced optimization algorithms, quantum circuit designs informed by fractal patterns, cryptographic schemes leveraging fractal chaos for security, and expansive AI models mirroring cognitive hierarchies. A refined research design employing Python libraries is proffered for empirical scrutiny. Spanning mathematics, informatics, physics, and security domains, this exposition elucidates fractal algebra's prowess in broadening computational and cryptographic horizons.

AI.tldr: 分形代数是一种将分形特性（自相似性、递归缩放、层次结构）融入经典代数框架的新数学范式，在神经网络、空间编程、优化、量子计算、密码学和人工智能等领域具有变革潜力。

AI.motivation: 传统代数框架在处理复杂、迭代、多尺度系统时存在局限性，需要新的数学范式来建模具有分形特性的系统，以推动神经网络、优化算法、量子计算等前沿领域的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形代数理论框架，包括自相似性、递归缩放、层次结构等分形特性与经典代数的融合，为复杂系统建模提供理论基础。
AI.method: 提出使用Python库进行实证研究的精炼研究设计，通过编程实现分形代数概念并验证其应用效果。
AI.findings: 分形代数在多个领域具有应用潜力：分形神经网络可提高深度学习效率；多尺度空间数据处理；分形增强优化算法；基于分形模式的量子电路设计；利用分形混沌的密码学方案；模拟认知层次的AI模型。
