title: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution
affiliations: University of Virginia School of Law

detail.title: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution

publicationDetails.detailsText: Virginia Public Law and Legal Theory Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Virginia Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Something is amiss in empirical economics. Despite the advances of the credibility revolution, published estimates tend to be inflated and overconfident. We argue that this stems from a weakness in the dominant econometric framework: treating the researcher like a calculator that mechanically implements the econometric method. We use several examples to show how properties of estimators change dramatically with humans-in-the-loop. Under plausible assumptions on researcher behavior, low-power estimators such as instrumental variables exhibit high degrees of bias, even with a first-stage F-statistic of 200. Threshold testing on the first-stage F-statistic can reduce bias, contrary to Angrist and Kolesár (2024). And standard errors understate uncertainty, since they ignore variation due to researchers' subjective choices. Ignoring the role of humans "in the research loop" can lead to highly biased and unreliable findings. Modifying econometric practices to address the human factor is a critical frontier of the credibility revolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，尽管可信度革命取得进展，但实证经济学中发表的估计值往往存在夸大和过度自信的问题。作者认为这源于主流计量经济学框架的缺陷：将研究者视为机械执行计量方法的计算器。论文通过多个例子展示了当研究者参与研究过程时，估计量的性质会发生显著变化。在合理的假设下，即使第一阶段F统计量高达200，低功效估计量（如工具变量）仍会存在高度偏差。阈值检验可以减少这种偏差，而标准误则低估了不确定性，因为它们忽略了研究者主观选择带来的变异。
AI.research_question: 研究者作为"研究循环"中的主观决策者如何影响计量估计的偏差和不确定性？
AI.motivation: 尽管可信度革命在实证经济学中取得进展，但发表的估计值仍然存在夸大和过度自信的问题。作者认为这源于当前计量经济学框架忽略了研究者在研究过程中的主观作用，将研究者视为机械执行计量方法的计算器。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文挑战了传统计量经济学框架中将研究者视为"计算器"的假设，提出了"研究循环中的人类"框架，强调研究者的主观决策（如模型选择、变量定义、统计检验阈值等）对估计结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用多个实证例子和模拟分析，展示当研究者参与研究过程时估计量性质的变化。在合理的假设下分析低功效估计量（如工具变量）的偏差情况，并检验阈值测试对偏差的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 在研究者参与的情况下，即使第一阶段F统计量高达200，工具变量等低功效估计量仍会存在高度偏差；2. 阈值检验可以降低这种偏差，这与Angrist和Kolesár（2024）的观点相反；3. 标准误低估了不确定性，因为它们忽略了研究者主观选择带来的变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"研究循环中的人类"理论框架，挑战了传统计量经济学中将研究者视为机械执行者的假设；2. 展示了研究者主观决策如何系统性影响估计量的偏差和不确定性；3. 为可信度革命提供了新的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议修改计量实践以考虑"人类因素"；2. 提供阈值检验作为减少偏差的实际方法；3. 指出标准误计算需要纳入研究者主观选择的变异；4. 为实证研究提供更可靠的评估框架。

title: Droughts and Domestic Violence: Measuring the Gender-Climate Nexus
affiliations: Tecnológico de Monterrey and Harvard University

detail.title: Droughts and Domestic Violence: Measuring the Gender-Climate Nexus
detail.abstract: Every year, 245 million women are victims of intimate partner violence (IPV). Climate change is hypothesized to exacerbate this figure through its disruptive impact on household livelihoods, among other channels. However, little causal evidence exists on this aspect of the climate-gender nexus, partly due to measurement challenges that have contributed to gaps in the literature. In this paper, we use three different IPV data sources to examine the effect of drought in Mexico and the role of agricultural vulnerability in intensifying these effects. We find robust evidence of increases in all measures of IPV in response to local precipitation deficits: as unanticipated exposure to days without rain in the previous month rises, more injuries linked to IPV are recorded in the public health system, police reports increase, and more 911 calls related to IPV are made. The effects are stronger in regions highly dependent on agriculture, particularly when the shock occurs during the growing season. In a country where men control most agricultural income and land, our results align with theoretical predictions from male-backlash IPV models and extractive violence models. We also find that the impact of drought on IPV is more pronounced in municipalities with low state capacity, though potential differences in reporting behavior between IPV measures complicate comparisons. Our findings underscore the need to design gender-sensitive disaster relief policies, strengthen trust in reporting mechanisms and helplines, and reduce the social acceptability of IPV.

AI.tldr: 研究使用墨西哥三种不同的亲密伴侣暴力数据源，发现干旱显著增加IPV发生率，农业依赖地区效应更强，结果支持男性反击和榨取暴力理论模型。
AI.research_question: 干旱如何影响墨西哥的亲密伴侣暴力发生率？农业依赖和季节因素如何调节这种效应？
AI.motivation: 每年有2.45亿女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力，气候变化可能通过破坏家庭生计等渠道加剧这一问题，但缺乏因果证据，部分原因是测量挑战导致文献空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 男性反击IPV模型和榨取暴力模型，强调在男性控制农业收入和土地的情况下，经济压力可能导致家庭暴力增加。
AI.method: 使用墨西哥三种不同的IPV数据源（公共卫生系统记录、警方报告、911电话），分析当地降水赤字对IPV的影响，特别关注农业依赖地区和生长季节的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. 当地降水赤字显著增加所有IPV测量指标；2. 农业依赖地区效应更强，特别是生长季节的冲击；3. 国家能力低的市镇效应更明显；4. 结果支持男性反击和榨取暴力理论预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候-性别关系提供因果证据，验证男性反击IPV模型和榨取暴力模型在气候变化背景下的适用性，填补文献空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要设计性别敏感的灾害救济政策，加强报告机制和求助热线的信任度，降低IPV的社会接受度。

title: The Great Redistribution that Wasn’t: A HANK-OLG Perspective on Monetary Policy
affiliations: National Bank of Poland and

detail.title: The Great Redistribution that Wasn’t: A HANK-OLG Perspective on Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study the distributional consequences of the recent inflationary surge and the subsequent monetary policy response in the euro area. Using an estimated two-asset Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model with an overlapping generations structure, we analyze the macroeconomic shocks driving inflation between 2021 and 2022. We find that these shocks generated substantial redistribution from young and poor households toward older and wealthier ones. By keeping interest rates unchanged until mid-2022, monetary policy largely offset these distributional effects. A policy response based solely on a standard Taylor rule would have failed to mitigate the redistribution.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用异质代理人新凯恩斯模型分析欧元区通胀飙升及其货币政策响应的分配效应，发现通胀冲击导致财富从年轻贫困家庭向年长富裕家庭再分配，而延迟加息的货币政策有效抵消了这种再分配效应。
AI.research_question: 欧元区近期通胀飙升及其货币政策响应如何影响不同年龄和财富群体的收入分配？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀冲击及其政策响应的分配后果对于评估经济政策的公平性和有效性至关重要，特别是在当前高通胀环境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质代理人新凯恩斯模型（HANK）与世代重叠结构，结合两资产配置框架分析分配效应。
AI.method: 使用估计的两资产异质代理人新凯恩斯模型，分析2021-2022年间驱动通胀的宏观经济冲击及其分配效应。
AI.findings: 通胀冲击导致显著再分配：财富从年轻和贫困家庭流向年长和富裕家庭；延迟加息的货币政策有效抵消了这种再分配效应；标准泰勒规则无法实现相同的分配保护效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分配分析纳入新凯恩斯框架，揭示货币政策延迟响应对分配后果的缓冲作用，挑战传统泰勒规则在分配保护方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估通胀政策分配后果的分析框架，支持延迟加息政策在保护弱势群体方面的合理性，为货币政策设计提供分配视角。

title: Environmental regulation and FDI: Mergers and Acquisitions versus Greenfield Investment
affiliations: University of Granada, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Granada - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: Environmental regulation and FDI: Mergers and Acquisitions versus Greenfield Investment
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of environmental regulation (ER) on foreign direct investment (FDI) location decisions, using a gravity model covering the period 2003–2018. We examine how ER in both origin and destination countries influences bilateral FDI flows, distinguishing between greenfield (GF) investments and cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M\&As). To our knowledge, this is the first study of FDI location decisions to jointly analyse the responses of bilateral M\&A and GF projects to ER across a large sample of developed and developing countries and manufacturing industries. Overall, we find no consistent evidence supporting either the pollution haven hypothesis (PHH) or the green haven hypothesis (GHH) for total FDI. However, results differ by mode of investment: stricter ER in the origin country encourages outward M\&As, but has no significant effect on GF projects. Conversely, ER in host countries appears to exert limited pull effects. Further analysis by sector (clean versus dirty industries) and by country income level reveals important heterogeneity in these effects. For pollution-intensive sectors, tighter regulation in high-income countries is associated with greater outward M\&A activity and GF investment directed toward low- and middle-income hosts—an allocation consistent with the PHH. In contrast, in clean industries, GF investment is positively associated with stricter ER in the origin country, lending support to the GHH. Taken together, these results suggest that stricter ER need not deter investment, especially in clean industries or via GF projects; however, in pollution-intensive activities, reallocation through cross-border M\&As toward low- and middle-income countries remains a concern.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用引力模型分析2003-2018年环境规制对FDI区位决策的影响，区分绿地投资和跨境并购。研究发现总体FDI不支持污染避难所假说或绿色避难所假说，但投资模式、行业和收入水平存在异质性效应。
AI.research_question: 环境规制如何影响外国直接投资的区位决策？具体而言，来源国和东道国的环境规制如何影响双边绿地投资和跨境并购？
AI.motivation: 环境规制与FDI关系存在理论争议（污染避难所假说vs绿色避难所假说），现有研究缺乏对投资模式（绿地vs并购）和行业异质性的综合分析，需要更细致的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 污染避难所假说（PHH）：严格环境规制导致污染产业向规制宽松国家转移；绿色避难所假说（GHH）：严格环境规制吸引清洁技术和绿色产业投资；引力模型框架分析双边投资流动。
AI.method: 使用2003-2018年面板数据的引力模型，覆盖发达国家和发展中国家制造业，区分绿地投资和跨境并购两种投资模式，按行业清洁程度和收入水平进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 总体FDI不支持PHH或GHH；2. 来源国严格环境规制促进对外并购，但不影响绿地投资；3. 东道国规制拉动效应有限；4. 污染密集型行业：高收入国家严格规制导致投资流向中低收入国家（支持PHH）；5. 清洁行业：来源国严格规制促进绿地投资（支持GHH）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次同时分析双边并购和绿地投资对环境规制的响应，揭示了投资模式的异质性效应；为PHH和GHH提供了更细致的实证证据，表明两种假说在不同情境下可能同时成立。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：严格环境规制不一定抑制投资，尤其在清洁行业；但需关注污染密集型行业通过跨境并购向中低收入国家转移的风险；投资促进政策应考虑行业特性和投资模式差异。

title: Carbon Credit Trading and India’s Green Transition
affiliations: , Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research and Reserve Bank of India

detail.title: Carbon Credit Trading and India’s Green Transition
detail.abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic and environmental implications of India’s newly introduced Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), an intensity-based emissions trading system that incentivizes target-achieving firms through free allocation of carbon certificates tradable in secondary carbon markets. We employ an Environmental-Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium model with a secondary carbon market and two energy sectors (thermal power and green electricity). Unlike conventional models, the model captures firms’ endogenous abatement and green electricity adoption responses to the incentive mechanism. We find three key results. First, CCTS policy promotes energy transition and reduction in emissions in the long term by lowering the marginal cost of production. Second, while fossil fuel phase-out remains a challenge in the short term, a stricter target and cheaper green electricity can accelerate the transition. Third, the incentive effect of the CCTS acts as a macroeconomic stabilizer against fossil fuel price volatilities, converting real shocks into financial adjustments through the certificate market mechanism. Finally, the CCTS outperforms the price-based carbon tax in transition while sustaining the growth objectives. Thus, intensity-based emissions trading with free allocation enables green transition while avoiding the high output costs of carbon taxation, making it the preferred policy choice for developing economies like India.

AI.tldr: 印度碳信用交易计划（CCTS）通过强度基准排放交易和免费分配碳证书，促进长期能源转型和减排，同时作为宏观经济稳定器应对化石燃料价格波动，相比碳税更适合发展中国家。
AI.research_question: 印度碳信用交易计划（CCTS）对宏观经济和环境有何影响？与碳税相比，哪种政策更适合印度这样的发展中国家？
AI.motivation: 印度作为发展中经济体，需要在实现经济增长目标的同时推进绿色转型，需要评估新推出的碳信用交易计划的有效性及其与碳税政策的比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境-动态随机一般均衡模型，包含二级碳市场和两个能源部门（火电和绿色电力），捕捉企业内生减排和绿色电力采用对激励机制的响应。
AI.method: 采用包含二级碳市场和两个能源部门的环境-动态随机一般均衡模型，不同于传统模型，该模型能够捕捉企业对激励机制的内生减排和绿色电力采用反应。
AI.findings: 1. CCTS政策通过降低边际生产成本，促进长期能源转型和减排；2. 短期化石燃料淘汰仍具挑战，但更严格目标和更便宜绿色电力可加速转型；3. CCTS激励效应可作为宏观经济稳定器，通过证书市场机制将实际冲击转化为金融调整；4. CCTS在转型方面优于价格型碳税，同时保持增长目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了包含二级碳市场和内生企业行为的环境-动态随机一般均衡模型，为评估强度基准排放交易政策提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度等发展中国家提供了政策建议：强度基准排放交易配合免费分配碳证书，既能实现绿色转型，又能避免碳税的高产出成本，是更优的政策选择。

title: Investment under Government Ownership: Evidence from Oil and Gas Drilling on the Wyoming Checkerboard
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and The College of New Jersey

detail.title: Investment under Government Ownership: Evidence from Oil and Gas Drilling on the Wyoming Checkerboard
detail.abstract: We study how government ownership affects investment in oil and gas production using a natural experiment created by the Wyoming railroad checkerboard, where federally and privately owned parcels alternate at the square-mile level. Despite near-identical geology, federal land sees substantially less drilling over time. We estimate that federal ownership imposes an implicit cost on operators equivalent to 14 percent of drilling costs per well, providing a benchmark with which to evaluate environmental benefits arising from federal ownership. We find that increased permitting delays are the primary driver of our results, highlighting the economic importance of process costs in public bureaucracies.

AI.tldr: 政府所有权通过增加许可延迟显著抑制了油气钻探活动，联邦土地上的钻探成本相当于增加了14%的隐性成本
AI.research_question: 政府所有权如何影响油气生产投资？具体机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解政府所有权对自然资源开发的影响，特别是通过公共官僚机构的程序成本如何影响经济活动
AI.theoretical_framework: 产权理论、公共选择理论、官僚机构效率理论
AI.method: 利用怀俄明州铁路棋盘格自然实验，比较地质条件几乎相同但所有权（联邦vs私人）交替的相邻地块
AI.findings: 1. 联邦土地钻探活动显著少于私人土地；2. 联邦所有权带来的隐性成本相当于每口井钻探成本的14%；3. 许可延迟是主要驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了公共官僚机构程序成本的经济重要性，为评估政府所有权的环境效益提供了基准
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了政府所有权成本的具体量化指标，有助于平衡资源开发与环境保护的决策

title: Long-Term Impacts of Climate Change on Electricity Demand and Household Expenditure in Saudi Arabia
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC), King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center, King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center, King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC) and International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)

detail.title: Long-Term Impacts of Climate Change on Electricity Demand and Household Expenditure in Saudi Arabia
detail.abstract: With regional warming across the Arabian Peninsula occurring at twice the global average and driving summer peak electricity loads to nearly 80% of total system capacity, understanding long-term energy implications is critical for Saudi Arabia’s national climate resilience. Consequently, this study assesses the impacts of climate change on thermal comfort, energy demand, and household electricity expenditure through 2100. Using the multi-sectoral Global Change Assessment Model for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (GCAM-KSA), we integrated three regionally updated Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP1-3) with two climate pathways: RCP7.0 (high impact) and RCP2.6 (low impact). Our results indicate a shift in thermal conditions by 2100 relative to the 1981–2014 baseline. Cooling Degree Days (CDD) are projected to increase up to 24% and 80% under the low and high-impact pathways, respectively, while Heating Degree Days (HDD) remain negligible. Furthermore, the temporal distribution of CDD expands significantly, representing a substantial lengthening of the summer season beyond mid-century. By isolating socioeconomic and climate drivers, we find that high socioeconomic development (SSP3) initially drives a 33–53% rise in cooling demand through 2060 compared to 2025. However, climate impacts emerge as the dominant accelerator between 2060 and 2100, independently driving cooling service demand up by an additional 38–49% (RCP7.0) and 13–16% (RCP2.6). Consequently, annual average household expenditures attributable to climate impacts are projected to increase by 32–45% (RCP7.0) and 7–11% (RCP2.6) in 2100. These findings highlight the importance of integrating climate adaptation strategies into long-term energy planning to mitigate rising household expenditure.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用GCAM-KSA模型评估气候变化对沙特阿拉伯热舒适度、能源需求和家庭电费支出的影响至2100年。结果显示，冷却度日数将显著增加，夏季延长，社会经济因素在2060年前主导制冷需求增长，而2060年后气候变化影响成为主要驱动因素，导致家庭电费支出大幅上升。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何影响沙特阿拉伯的热舒适度、能源需求和家庭电费支出至2100年？
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯半岛地区变暖速度是全球平均的两倍，夏季峰值电力负荷已接近系统总容量的80%，理解长期能源影响对沙特的国家气候韧性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球变化评估模型（GCAM-KSA），整合三种区域更新的共享社会经济路径（SSP1-3）和两种气候路径（RCP7.0高影响和RCP2.6低影响）。
AI.method: 使用多部门全球变化评估模型（GCAM-KSA），整合SSP1-3社会经济情景与RCP7.0/RCP2.6气候路径，分析冷却度日数（CDD）和加热度日数（HDD）变化，分离社会经济和气候驱动因素。
AI.findings: 1. 到2100年，冷却度日数在低/高影响路径下分别增加24%和80%；2. 夏季季节显著延长；3. 2060年前社会经济因素驱动制冷需求增长33-53%；4. 2060-2100年气候影响成为主导因素，额外增加制冷需求38-49%（RCP7.0）和13-16%（RCP2.6）；5. 家庭电费支出因气候影响增加32-45%（RCP7.0）和7-11%（RCP2.6）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了气候变化对沙特阿拉伯能源需求影响的综合评估框架；2. 分离了社会经济和气候因素的相对贡献；3. 揭示了不同时间尺度上驱动因素的变化规律；4. 建立了热舒适度指标与能源需求的量化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为沙特长期能源规划提供科学依据；2. 强调将气候适应策略纳入能源政策的重要性；3. 帮助政策制定者预测和缓解家庭电费负担；4. 支持气候韧性建设，保障能源系统稳定。

title: The Ukraine War Prospect: How Peace Plans Might Work and Why They Will Fail

detail.title: The Ukraine War Prospect: How Peace Plans Might Work and Why They Will Fail
detail.abstract: During 2025 multiple contending Ukraine peace and cease-fire proposals were put forward by the Trump administration and America’s European partners. This article examines how the leading official proposals fell short. And it presents two, simpler proposals better aligned with battlefield realities. The article also explores the evolution of US, Ukrainian, Russian, and West European public opinion on the war.

AI.tldr: 该文分析了2025年美欧提出的乌克兰和平与停火提案的不足，提出了两个更符合战场现实的简化方案，并探讨了美乌俄及西欧公众对战争态度的演变。
AI.research_question: 2025年美欧提出的乌克兰和平与停火提案为何未能成功？如何设计更符合战场现实的和平方案？美乌俄及西欧公众对战争的态度如何演变？
AI.motivation: 2025年各方提出的和平提案未能有效解决乌克兰冲突，需要分析其失败原因并提出更可行的替代方案，同时理解公众舆论演变对和平进程的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突解决理论、和平谈判框架、公众舆论对国际关系的影响、现实主义国际关系理论。
AI.method: 提案内容分析、战场现实评估、公众舆论调查数据分析、比较案例研究。
AI.findings: 现有提案过于复杂且脱离战场现实；简化提案更可能成功；各方公众对战争的态度随时间发生显著变化，影响和平谈判立场。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于战场现实的和平提案设计框架，扩展了公众舆论在冲突解决中的作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了两个更可行的和平方案，帮助理解各方公众态度变化对谈判策略的影响。

title: From Network Fundamentals to Macro-Financial Integration: The Evolving Predictability of Bitcoin Returns
affiliations: University of Sao Paulo (USP), Faculty of Economics, Administration and Accounting (FEA), Department of Administration, Students, Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) and Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)

detail.title: From Network Fundamentals to Macro-Financial Integration: The Evolving Predictability of Bitcoin Returns
detail.abstract: We examine how the sources of return predictability in Bitcoin evolve as the market integrates with traditional finance. Using daily data from 2014 to 2025, we identify regimes with the sparse change-point method of Dufays and Rombouts [2020]. In each regime, we assess horizon-specific predictability using Breitung-Candelon frequencydomain Granger causality [Breitung and Candelon, 2006] and transfer entropy. Predictors include macro-finance variables (equities, volatility, the dollar, commodities, and Treasury yields and term structure) and crypto-native measures constructed from blockchain and derivatives data. Crypto-native valuation and positioning variables, in particular the market-to-realized value ratio, funding rates, and open interest, predict Bitcoin returns in every regime. Macro-finance variables gain forecasting power after 2019 and become most informative during the 2022-2023 tightening episode, when nonlinear information flows from traditional markets to Bitcoin are strongest. The results imply that Bitcoin's return dynamics are shaped by internal valuation and leverage cycles throughout, while its exposure to global risk conditions is episodic and concentrated in stress periods.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了比特币收益可预测性的来源如何随着市场与传统金融的整合而演变。研究发现，加密原生变量（如市场实现价值比、资金费率等）在所有时期都能预测比特币收益，而宏观金融变量在2019年后获得预测能力，在2022-2023年紧缩时期最为有效。
AI.research_question: 比特币收益可预测性的来源如何随着市场与传统金融的整合而演变？
AI.motivation: 随着比特币市场逐渐与传统金融体系整合，需要了解其收益可预测性的动态变化，以及加密原生变量和传统宏观金融变量在不同市场阶段的预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场整合理论、收益可预测性理论、风险传导机制、加密资产定价理论
AI.method: 使用2014-2025年日度数据，采用Dufays和Rombouts [2020]的稀疏变点方法识别市场制度。在每个制度内，使用Breitung-Candelon频域格兰杰因果关系和转移熵评估特定时间跨度的可预测性。预测变量包括宏观金融变量（股票、波动率、美元、商品、国债收益率和期限结构）和加密原生指标（基于区块链和衍生品数据构建）。
AI.findings: 1. 加密原生估值和持仓变量（特别是市场实现价值比、资金费率、未平仓合约）在所有制度下都能预测比特币收益；2. 宏观金融变量在2019年后获得预测能力，在2022-2023年紧缩时期最为有效，此时从传统市场到比特币的非线性信息流最强；3. 比特币的收益动态始终受内部估值和杠杆周期影响，而对全球风险条件的暴露是间歇性的，主要集中在压力时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了比特币收益可预测性来源随市场整合的动态演变；2. 区分了加密原生因素和传统金融因素在不同市场阶段的相对重要性；3. 提供了比特币与传统金融市场整合程度的实证证据；4. 拓展了加密资产定价理论，强调了市场制度依赖的特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了在不同市场环境下预测比特币收益的有效工具组合；2. 帮助风险管理者和监管机构理解比特币与传统金融市场的关联性；3. 为资产配置决策提供了实证依据，特别是在压力时期的风险管理；4. 为加密货币市场参与者提供了实用的预测指标框架。

title: Can Satellites Predict Oil Demand?
affiliations: Banque de France, , European Central Bank (ECB),  and Equancy

detail.title: Can Satellites Predict Oil Demand?

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We investigate whether satellite observations of nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) – a short-lived pollutant primarily emitted by fossil fuel combustion – can improve the forecasting of oil demand. After retrieving, cleaning, and aggregating daily satellite data, we integrate NO₂ into a range of forecasting models. Across a panel of advanced and emerging economies, we find that including NO₂ significantly enhances nowcasting accuracy relative to benchmark models based on autoregressive terms and traditional predictors such as industrial activity, prices, weather, and vehicle registrations. Accuracy gains are particularly strong during crisis episodes but remain present in more stable times. Non-linear models, especially neural networks, yield the largest improvements, highlighting the non-linear link between energy demand and pollution. By offering a timely, globally consistent, and freely available proxy, satellite-based NO₂ data provide a valuable new tool for real-time monitoring of oil dema

AI.tldr: 卫星观测的二氧化氮（NO₂）数据可以显著提高石油需求的预测精度，特别是在危机时期，非线性模型（如神经网络）效果最佳
AI.research_question: 卫星观测的二氧化氮（NO₂）数据是否能改善石油需求的预测？
AI.motivation: 化石燃料燃烧排放的NO₂是短期污染物，可作为石油需求的实时代理指标，提供及时、全球一致且免费的数据源
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源需求与污染之间的非线性关系理论，卫星遥感数据在经济预测中的应用理论
AI.method: 检索、清理和聚合每日卫星NO₂数据，将其整合到多种预测模型中，包括基准自回归模型和包含工业活动、价格、天气、车辆登记等传统预测因子的模型
AI.findings: 包含NO₂数据显著提高了即时预测精度，特别是在危机时期，但在稳定时期也有改善；非线性模型（尤其是神经网络）改进最大
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了能源需求与污染之间的非线性关系，扩展了卫星遥感数据在经济预测领域的应用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实时、全球一致且免费的石油需求监测工具，为政策制定者和市场参与者提供更准确的预测方法

title: Content Curation and Disseminators' Primary Copyright Liability in Access-based Attention Markets
affiliations: Curtin University - Curtin Law School

detail.title: Content Curation and Disseminators' Primary Copyright Liability in Access-based Attention Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: IIC - International Review of Intellectual Property and Competition Law, 0[10.1007/s40319-025-01669-3]
IIC - International Review of Intellectual Property and Competition Law (2026)

detail.abstract: In an era of content abundance and attention scarcity, curation is key. Online content disseminators provide the public with access to content, while harnessing the value of audience attention and data. Content curation by disseminators, whether conscious or automated, could lead to infringement of the right to communicate to the public. This is exhibited in judicial interpretations and emerging legislative frameworks in the European Union, United States and Australia, even if the link between curation and liability is not always made clear. In other words, courts assessing primary infringement of the communication right are already taking curation into account, regardless of whether it is an explicit part of the analytical framework. In the interest of transparent decision-making, this article advocates for clearer recognition of disseminators' curatorial roles and interests in interpretations of the communication right, a central right in access-based dissemination markets. The article proposes questions and factors for evaluating infringement by curation, with more careful consideration of factors such as substitutability with existing services.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在线内容传播者在内容策展中的角色如何影响传播权的侵权认定，主张在传播权解释中更明确地承认传播者的策展角色和利益。
AI.research_question: 在线内容传播者的策展行为如何影响传播权的侵权认定？如何在传播权解释中更明确地承认传播者的策展角色和利益？
AI.motivation: 在内容过剩和注意力稀缺的时代，策展变得至关重要。在线内容传播者向公众提供内容访问，同时利用受众注意力和数据的价值。传播者的内容策展（无论是自觉的还是自动化的）可能导致传播权的侵权，但策展与责任之间的联系在司法实践中并不总是清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传播权（right to communicate to the public）作为基于访问的传播市场的核心权利；内容策展理论；欧盟、美国和澳大利亚的司法解释和新兴立法框架。
AI.method: 法律分析和比较研究：分析欧盟、美国和澳大利亚的司法解释和立法框架，考察法院在评估传播权主要侵权时如何考虑策展因素。
AI.findings: 法院在评估传播权主要侵权时已经在考虑策展因素，无论这是否是分析框架的明确部分。策展与责任之间的联系在现有司法实践中并不总是清晰。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出在传播权解释中更明确地承认传播者的策展角色和利益的理论框架；为评估策展侵权提出问题和因素，包括与现有服务的可替代性等关键因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为透明决策提供指导：主张在传播权侵权认定中更明确地考虑策展因素；为立法者和司法实践提供评估策展侵权的具体问题和因素框架。

title: Bidding and Entry Behavior in Surplus-Extracting Auctions: An Experiment
affiliations: Hosei University - Department of Economics and The University of Osaka - Institute of Social and Economic Research

detail.title: Bidding and Entry Behavior in Surplus-Extracting Auctions: An Experiment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The experiment reported in this study was approved by the Institutional Review Boards of the Institute of Social and Economic Research (ISER), University of Osaka (no. 20221201, approved on December 9, 2022), and the Research Institute for Socionetwork Strategies (RISS), Kansai University (no. 2022028, approved on December 23, 2022).
declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge financial support provided by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science, KAKENHI (grant nos. 18K12747, 18K19954, 20H05631, 23H00051, 23H00055, 23K01315, 25H00388), along with the Joint Usage/Research Center for Behavioral Economics at ISER and the Joint Usage/Research Center at RISS.

detail.abstract: This study experimentally investigates bidding behavior and entry decisions in auctions designed for surplus extraction. The surplus-extracting auctions are based on the second-price auction format. We explicitly incorporate an opt-out option to examine the interaction between bidding and entry. Our results show that entry rates decline over time, while overbid amounts conditional on entry increase. To interpret these behavioral patterns, we analyze learning dynamics, which suggest that the full-entry value-bidding equilibrium attracts behavior only from a relatively small set of initial conditions. We also apply a quantal response equilibrium framework to capture systematic deviations from Nash equilibrium benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 实验研究拍卖中的投标行为和进入决策，重点关注剩余提取拍卖。研究发现进入率随时间下降，但进入后的过高投标增加。学习动态分析表明，完全进入-价值投标均衡只吸引少量初始条件的行为。使用量化响应均衡框架捕捉与纳什均衡的系统性偏差。
AI.research_question: 在剩余提取拍卖中，投标者的进入决策和投标行为如何相互作用？这些行为如何随时间演变？与理论均衡预测相比存在哪些系统性偏差？
AI.motivation: 理解拍卖中投标行为与进入决策的相互作用对于设计有效的拍卖机制至关重要。剩余提取拍卖在实践中广泛应用，但投标者行为与理论预测可能存在偏差，需要通过实验研究来揭示这些行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于第二价格拍卖的剩余提取拍卖理论；纳什均衡理论；学习动态理论；量化响应均衡（QRE）框架
AI.method: 实验研究方法，设计包含退出选项的剩余提取拍卖实验，观察投标者的进入决策和投标行为随时间的变化，分析学习动态，应用量化响应均衡框架解释行为偏差。
AI.findings: 1. 进入率随时间下降；2. 进入后的过高投标金额增加；3. 完全进入-价值投标均衡只吸引少量初始条件的行为；4. 存在系统性偏离纳什均衡的行为模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了剩余提取拍卖中进入决策与投标行为的动态关系；2. 应用学习动态理论解释均衡收敛的局限性；3. 使用量化响应均衡框架更好地捕捉实际行为模式；4. 为拍卖理论提供了行为微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拍卖设计者提供关于投标者行为模式的实证依据；2. 帮助预测拍卖参与率和投标水平；3. 为优化拍卖机制设计提供参考；4. 对实际拍卖中的进入决策管理具有指导意义。

title: Compliance, Cost and User Fees in the Early Childhood Care and Education Sector in South Africa
affiliations: Stellenbosch University and Stellenbosch University

detail.title: Compliance, Cost and User Fees in the Early Childhood Care and Education Sector in South Africa
detail.abstract: There are significant lifelong impacts of quality early childhood care and education (ECCE) interventions on children’s health, development, education and future life prospects, but the costs of these services are often cited as a barrier to attending ECCE programmes. With limited state funding for ECCE in South Africa, the financial burden often falls on parents or caregivers, where costs are passed on to users in the form of fees charged. Using the 2013/ 14 Early Childhood Development Audit, this paper generates metrics of compliance with norms and standards in the Children’s Act (Act 38 of 2005), explores variations in compliance across provinces and by registration status, and investigates patterns in user fees charged. It then explores how operational costs align with higher standards of programming, defined in terms of compliance with norms and standards. The paper then considers whether access to subsidies is passed on as fee reductions to parents or caregivers. The main findings include the following. First, a low proportion of ECCE programmes including fully registered programmes are compliant with norms and standards for partial care facilities and early childhood development programmes. Differences in compliance by registration status are not large enough to justify some programmes receiving subsidies over others. The mismatch between compliance and de jure registration status, with significant variation across provinces, also points to the ‘illegality’ of programmes operating under current legislation. Second, a significant positive association is observed between unit costs and programme compliance suggesting that more spending fetches higher standards of ECCE programming. Third, subsidies enable higher levels of spending for better programming. Without access to subsidies, programmes may pass on costs as higher fees to households. Fourth, ECCE programmes servicing poorer households bear the triple burden of trying to get government subsidies, providing exemptions and charging lower fees.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用南非2013/14年幼儿发展审计数据，分析幼儿保育与教育（ECCE）项目的合规性、运营成本与服务质量的关系，以及补贴政策对用户费用的影响。研究发现：1）ECCE项目合规率低，注册状态与合规性不匹配；2）单位成本与项目合规性正相关；3）补贴能提高项目支出和质量；4）服务贫困家庭的ECCE项目面临三重负担。
AI.research_question: 南非幼儿保育与教育（ECCE）项目的合规性现状如何？运营成本与服务质量（以合规性衡量）有何关系？政府补贴是否转化为对家长的费用减免？
AI.motivation: 高质量的ECCE对儿童终身发展有重要影响，但费用是参与的主要障碍。在南非，由于政府资金有限，费用负担主要落在家长身上。需要了解ECCE项目的合规性、成本结构和补贴政策如何影响服务质量和可及性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共经济学和早期儿童发展理论，探讨政府补贴、运营成本、服务质量（合规性）和用户费用之间的关系框架。
AI.method: 使用2013/14年南非幼儿发展审计数据，分析ECCE项目对《儿童法案》（2005年第38号法案）规范的合规性，比较各省份和注册状态的差异，研究用户费用模式，并检验运营成本与合规性的关系。
AI.findings: 1）ECCE项目合规率低，包括已注册项目；注册状态与合规性差异不大；各省合规性差异显著。2）单位成本与项目合规性正相关，表明更高支出带来更高质量。3）补贴能提高项目支出和质量，无补贴项目会将成本转嫁给家庭。4）服务贫困家庭的ECCE项目面临获取补贴、提供费用减免和收取较低费用的三重负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了发展中国家ECCE系统中合规性、补贴和用户费用之间的复杂关系。2）提出了"三重负担"概念，描述服务贫困家庭的ECCE机构面临的独特挑战。3）实证验证了运营成本与服务质量的正向关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供证据，说明当前补贴分配机制需要改革。2）建议重新评估注册与合规性的关系。3）提出需要针对性支持服务贫困社区的ECCE项目。4）为改善ECCE可及性和质量提供政策建议。

title: When Do Loss-Averse Households Retire? Intertemporal Loss Aversion and Sticky Consumption
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Applied Mathematics  and Sungshin Women's University

detail.title: When Do Loss-Averse Households Retire? Intertemporal Loss Aversion and Sticky Consumption
detail.abstract: We study optimal consumption, portfolio choice, and retirement under intertemporal loss aversion, where downward consumption adjustments are psychologically costly. Using a dual martingale approach, we derive optimal policies in closed form. The model reveals a "golden handcuff" mechanism: households delay retirement not because they value work, but because retirement eliminates the labor income buffer, raising the risk of painful future consumption cuts. Stronger loss aversion widens the inaction region-inducing an "upgrade less, cut later" behavior-and significantly raises the wealth threshold for retirement, especially for households with high living standards. Furthermore, the model predicts a structural break in risk-taking: unlike the frictionless benchmark, the optimal portfolio exhibits sharp de-risking upon retirement due to the loss of the income buffer and amplified precautionary motives.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在跨期损失厌恶下，当消费向下调整会产生心理成本时，家庭的最优消费、投资组合选择和退休决策。研究发现存在"金手铐"机制：家庭推迟退休不是因为重视工作，而是因为退休消除了劳动收入缓冲，增加了未来痛苦消费削减的风险。更强的损失厌恶会扩大不作为区域，显著提高退休财富门槛，并导致退休时投资组合急剧去风险化。
AI.research_question: 在跨期损失厌恶（消费向下调整具有心理成本）的背景下，家庭如何做出最优的消费、投资组合选择和退休决策？这些决策如何相互影响？
AI.motivation: 传统生命周期模型假设消费调整是无摩擦的，但现实中消费向下调整往往带来心理痛苦（损失厌恶）。这种心理成本如何影响家庭的重要财务决策（特别是退休决策）尚未得到充分研究。理解这种机制对于解释观察到的退休行为（如延迟退休）和投资模式具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期损失厌恶理论（intertemporal loss aversion），将行为经济学中的损失厌恶概念扩展到跨期消费决策中。采用双重鞅方法（dual martingale approach）进行模型求解。结合生命周期理论、投资组合选择理论和退休决策理论。
AI.method: 采用理论建模方法，构建包含跨期损失厌恶的连续时间生命周期模型。使用双重鞅方法推导出最优政策的闭式解。通过比较静态分析研究损失厌恶强度、生活水平等因素对决策的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 发现"金手铐"机制：家庭推迟退休不是因为重视工作，而是因为退休消除了劳动收入缓冲，增加了未来痛苦消费削减的风险。
2. 更强的损失厌恶会扩大不作为区域，导致"少升级、晚削减"的行为模式。
3. 损失厌恶显著提高退休财富门槛，特别是对高生活水平的家庭。
4. 模型预测风险承担存在结构性断裂：与无摩擦基准不同，最优投资组合在退休时因收入缓冲的丧失和预防性动机的放大而急剧去风险化。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将损失厌恶整合到跨期消费和退休决策模型中，提供了新的理论框架。
2. 揭示了"金手铐"这一新的行为机制，解释了为什么家庭可能过度延迟退休。
3. 展示了损失厌恶如何导致投资组合决策在退休时发生结构性变化。
4. 提供了在行为偏好下最优政策的闭式解，为后续实证研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助理解现实中的退休决策行为，特别是为什么许多家庭即使积累了足够财富仍推迟退休。
2. 为财务顾问提供指导：应考虑客户的心理成本（损失厌恶）来制定退休规划。
3. 对退休政策设计有启示：应考虑心理因素对退休决策的影响。
4. 帮助投资者理解退休前后投资策略应如何调整，特别是去风险化的时机和程度。

title: Tokenizations for Austronesian Language Models: Study on Languages in Indonesia Archipelago
affiliations: Bandung Fe Institute and Bandung Fe Institute

detail.title: Tokenizations for Austronesian Language Models: Study on Languages in Indonesia Archipelago
detail.abstract: Tokenization constitutes a fundamental stage in Large Language Model (LLM) processing; however, subword-based tokenization methods optimized on English-dominant corpora may produce token fragmentation misaligned with the linguistic structures of Austronesian languages. This study aimed to develop a syllable-based tokenization framework adopting principles from traditional Indonesian scripts (aksara) for regional languages of Indonesia. A syllabic segmentation procedure was constructed based on the logic of abugida writing systems and implemented with a vocabulary of 2,843 tokens extracted from the Indonesian dictionary (KBBI). Evaluation was conducted on the NusaX dataset comprising 1,000 parallel translation samples across 10 regional languages, Indonesian, and English. Analysis employed Token per Character (TPC) ratio and sequence alignment using the Smith-Waterman algorithm. Results demonstrated that syllable-based tokenization yielded consistent TPC values (∼0.4) across all regional languages, whereas GPT-2 exhibited an inverse pattern with the lowest TPC for English. Syllable-based tokenization consistently produced higher token sequence similarity scores, with an average increase of approximately 21% (slope m ≈ 1.21) compared to GPT-2. These findings confirm that the syllable-based approach more effectively preserves phonological and morphological patterns across related Austronesian languages, offering a linguistically principled foundation for multilingual LLM development.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于音节的标记化框架，采用传统印尼文字（aksara）的原则，用于印尼地区语言。相比GPT-2的子词标记化，该方法在所有测试语言中产生更一致的标记字符比（TPC~0.4），并将标记序列相似性提高了约21%，更好地保留了南岛语系语言的语音和形态模式。
AI.research_question: 基于音节的标记化方法（采用传统印尼文字原则）是否比英语主导的子词标记化方法更能有效处理印尼地区南岛语系语言，并在标记效率和序列相似性方面表现更优？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型处理中的标记化阶段至关重要，但基于英语语料优化的子词标记化方法可能导致与南岛语系语言结构不匹配的标记碎片化问题。印尼地区语言具有独特的语音和形态特征，需要更适合其语言结构的标记化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 传统印尼文字（aksara）的abugida书写系统原则；2. 音节作为南岛语系语言基本语音单位的语言学理论；3. 标记化效率的Token per Character（TPC）指标；4. 序列相似性的Smith-Waterman算法。
AI.method: 1. 基于abugida书写系统逻辑构建音节分割程序；2. 从印尼语词典（KBBI）提取2,843个标记构建词汇表；3. 在NusaX数据集（包含10种地区语言、印尼语和英语的1,000个平行翻译样本）上评估；4. 使用TPC比率和Smith-Waterman算法进行序列对齐分析。
AI.findings: 1. 基于音节的标记化在所有地区语言中产生一致的TPC值（~0.4）；2. GPT-2显示相反模式，英语TPC最低；3. 基于音节的标记化比GPT-2平均提高约21%的标记序列相似性（斜率m≈1.21）；4. 该方法能更好地保留相关南岛语系语言的语音和形态模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于传统印尼文字原则的音节标记化理论框架；2. 验证了音节作为南岛语系语言标记化基本单位的有效性；3. 为多语言LLM开发提供了语言学原则基础；4. 挑战了英语主导的子词标记化范式在南岛语系语言中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了适用于印尼地区语言的音节标记化工具；2. 提供了包含2,843个标记的词汇表资源；3. 为多语言LLM开发者提供了更有效的南岛语系语言处理方案；4. 提高了印尼地区语言在NLP任务中的处理效率和准确性。

title: Why Do Firms Pay Different Interest Rates on Their Bank Loans?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, University of Chicago, Booth School of Business, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond and Columbia University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences - Department of Economics

detail.title: Why Do Firms Pay Different Interest Rates on Their Bank Loans?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Papers, volume 26, issue 03, 2026[10.21144/wp26-03]

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We document significant variation in interest rates among similar commercial and industrial loans using confidential supervisory data on the largest US banks. This dispersion does not appear to be due to risk. We rationalize the data using a search cost model and find that search costs are highest for smaller and riskier borrowers and lower for public firms, consistent with predictable differences in the costs of screening and monitoring. We find that search costs are substantial. Over a third of firms behave as if they do not comparison shop; half of all firms appear to only obtain two quotes before picking a lender; while the remaining firms behave as if they search widely.

AI.tldr: 使用美国大银行机密监管数据发现，相似商业贷款存在显著利率差异，这并非风险差异所致。通过搜索成本模型解释，发现搜索成本对小企业和高风险企业最高，对上市公司较低。约三分之一企业不比较报价，一半企业仅获取两个报价，其余企业广泛搜索。
AI.research_question: 为什么相似商业贷款之间存在显著的利率差异？这种差异是否由风险因素解释？企业贷款搜索行为如何影响利率分散？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为相似贷款应有相似利率，但实际观察到显著利率差异。需要理解这种差异的来源，特别是非风险因素的作用，以及企业搜索行为对贷款市场效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索成本模型（Search Cost Model），信息不对称理论，贷款市场竞争结构理论。
AI.method: 使用美国最大银行的机密监管数据，分析商业和工业贷款利率差异。构建搜索成本模型解释数据，通过实证分析识别搜索成本的决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 相似贷款存在显著利率差异，且非风险因素所致；2. 搜索成本对小企业和高风险企业最高，对上市公司较低；3. 约35%企业不比较报价，50%仅获取两个报价，其余广泛搜索；4. 搜索成本在贷款市场中具有实质性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为贷款市场利率分散提供搜索成本理论解释；2. 扩展了信息不对称理论在贷款市场的应用；3. 揭示了企业异质性搜索行为对市场效率的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助小企业和高风险企业理解贷款成本；2. 为银行定价策略提供参考；3. 为监管机构改善贷款市场竞争提供依据；4. 指导企业优化贷款搜索策略。

title: Bank Failures: The Roles of Solvency and Liquidity
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Bank Failures: The Roles of Solvency and Liquidity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Papers, volume 26, issue 02, 2026[10.21144/wp26-02]

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Bank failures can stem from runs on otherwise solvent banks or from losses that render banks insolvent, regardless of withdrawals. Disentangling the relative importance of liquidity and solvency in explaining bank failures is central to understanding financial crises and designing effective financial stability policies. This paper reviews evidence on the causes of bank failures. Bank failures — both with and without runs — are almost always related to poor fundamentals. Low recovery rates in failure suggest that most failed banks that experienced runs were likely fundamentally insolvent. Examiners' postmortem assessments also emphasize the primacy of poor asset quality and solvency problems. Before deposit insurance, runs commonly triggered the failure of insolvent banks. However, runs rarely caused the failure of strong banks, as such runs were typically resolved through other mechanisms, including interbank cooperation, equity injections, public signals of strength, or suspension of convertibility. We discuss the policy implications of these findings and outline directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 银行倒闭通常与基本面恶化相关，而非单纯的流动性挤兑。研究发现大多数经历挤兑的倒闭银行实际上已资不抵债，而基本面良好的银行很少因挤兑而倒闭。
AI.research_question: 在解释银行倒闭时，流动性和偿付能力哪个因素更为重要？如何区分两者对银行倒闭的相对影响？
AI.motivation: 理解银行倒闭的根本原因对于制定有效的金融稳定政策和应对金融危机至关重要。需要厘清流动性挤兑与偿付能力不足在银行倒闭中的相对作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行倒闭理论框架：区分流动性危机（挤兑）与偿付能力危机（资不抵债），分析两者在银行倒闭中的相互作用。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合历史证据、监管机构的事后评估、恢复率分析等多方面证据。
AI.findings: 1. 银行倒闭（无论有无挤兑）几乎总是与基本面恶化相关；2. 倒闭银行的低回收率表明经历挤兑的银行大多已资不抵债；3. 监管机构的事后评估强调资产质量和偿付能力问题是主要原因；4. 存款保险制度实施前，挤兑通常触发已资不抵债银行的倒闭；5. 基本面良好的银行很少因挤兑而倒闭，通常通过其他机制解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了银行倒闭中流动性与偿付能力的相对重要性，挑战了"纯粹流动性挤兑导致健康银行倒闭"的观点，强调了基本面因素的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融稳定政策设计提供依据：应更关注银行资产质量和偿付能力监管，而非单纯依赖流动性支持；存款保险制度的重要性；识别银行倒闭的早期预警信号。

title: Corporate Risk Management in an Era of Geopolitical Fragmentation Governance, Strategy, and Institutional Adaptation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Corporate Risk Management in an Era of Geopolitical Fragmentation Governance, Strategy, and Institutional Adaptation
detail.abstract:
This article advances a governance-centered theory of corporate risk management under conditions of geopolitical fragmentation. Prevailing enterprise risk management and political risk frameworks largely assume an institutional environment characterized by relative stability, regulatory convergence, and probabilistic uncertainty. Such assumptions are increasingly misaligned with a global economy shaped by sanctions regimes, trade policy divergence, economic statecraft, and cross-border regulatory conflict. In this setting, geopolitical risk functions less as an episodic external shock than as a persistent structural constraint that conditions the feasible set of corporate strategic choices.

The article develops a conceptual framework that reconceptualizes corporate risk management as an institutional governance mechanism through which firms allocate decision rights, structure escalation, and manage strategic trade-offs under enduring uncertainty. Integrating insights from corporate governance, international business, and political risk scholarship, the analysis theorizes a shift from optimization-oriented risk management toward constraint management, wherein firms prioritize strategic viability, organizational legitimacy, and regulatory durability across competing geopolitical regimes.

The article makes two principal contributions. First, it identifies a theoretical gap in existing literature, which inadequately explains how firms reorganize internally when geopolitical conditions reshape the operating environment itself rather than merely increasing volatility. Second, it articulates a governance-based model of risk internalization, explaining how board oversight, cross-functional integration, and strategic adaptation emerge as institutional responses to structural fragmentation. The argument positions governance capacity as a primary determinant of firm resilience and reframes corporate risk management as a central organizational capability in a fragmented global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以治理为中心的企业风险管理理论，适用于地缘政治碎片化环境。传统风险管理框架假设制度环境相对稳定，但当前全球经济的制裁制度、贸易政策分歧、经济治国术和跨境监管冲突使这些假设不再适用。文章将地缘政治风险重新概念化为持续性结构约束而非偶发性外部冲击，并构建了一个将企业风险管理重新定义为制度治理机制的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 在地缘政治碎片化条件下，企业如何通过内部治理机制重新组织风险管理，以应对结构性约束而非仅仅波动性增加？
AI.motivation: 传统企业风险管理和政治风险框架假设制度环境相对稳定、监管趋同和概率性不确定性，但这些假设与当前由制裁制度、贸易政策分歧、经济治国术和跨境监管冲突塑造的全球经济日益脱节。地缘政治风险已从偶发性外部冲击转变为持续性结构约束，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合公司治理、国际商务和政治风险研究的见解，提出以治理为中心的企业风险管理理论。将企业风险管理重新概念化为制度治理机制，强调从优化导向的风险管理向约束管理的转变，关注战略可行性、组织合法性和监管持久性。
AI.method: 概念性理论构建方法，通过整合多个学科领域的理论见解，发展新的概念框架。文章采用理论分析而非实证研究的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 地缘政治风险应被理解为持续性结构约束而非偶发性冲击；2. 企业风险管理应重新概念化为制度治理机制，涉及决策权分配、升级结构设计和战略权衡管理；3. 需要从优化导向的风险管理转向约束管理；4. 治理能力是企业韧性的主要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别现有文献的理论空白：未能充分解释当地缘政治条件重塑运营环境本身而非仅仅增加波动性时，企业如何内部重组；2. 阐述基于治理的风险内化模型，解释董事会监督、跨职能整合和战略适应如何作为对结构碎片化的制度性响应。
AI.practical_contributions: 将治理能力定位为企业韧性的主要决定因素，并将企业风险管理重新定义为碎片化全球经济中的核心组织能力。为企业在地缘政治碎片化环境中调整风险管理实践提供指导框架。

title: Design and Pricing of Temporal Consolidation in Last-Mile Delivery
affiliations: York University, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, York University and York University

detail.title: Design and Pricing of Temporal Consolidation in Last-Mile Delivery
detail.abstract: This research develops an analytical framework that integrates utility based customer choice and market segmentation with a continuous approximation of routing costs, linking customer adoption to transportation costs that vary with delivery frequency. We show that offering both subscription and per-order in temporally consolidated (TC) plans strictly dominates offering either plan alone, derive the optimal per order price in closed form, and characterize how the optimal delivery frequency depends on the distribution of customer order frequency. The analysis identifies profitability and viability conditions under which TC delivery outperforms same day delivery, particularly in low density markets and when customers exhibit moderate to high tolerance for delivery delays. Overall, the model provides actionable guidance for pricing and delivery frequency design in sustainable last mile logistics and for expanding service access in under served regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个分析框架，将基于效用的客户选择和市场细分与运输成本的连续近似相结合，将客户采用与随配送频率变化的运输成本联系起来。研究表明，在时间整合计划中同时提供订阅和按订单配送严格优于单独提供任一方案，推导出最优按订单价格的闭式解，并描述了最优配送频率如何取决于客户订单频率分布。分析确定了TC配送优于当日达的盈利性和可行性条件，特别是在低密度市场和客户对配送延迟具有中高容忍度时。
AI.research_question: 在可持续最后一公里物流中，如何通过时间整合配送计划（同时提供订阅和按订单选项）来优化定价和配送频率设计，以平衡客户采用和运输成本？
AI.motivation: 最后一公里物流面临可持续性和成本效益的挑战，特别是在低密度和欠服务地区。需要开发能够同时考虑客户选择和运输成本的分析框架，为物流服务提供商提供可行的定价和配送频率设计指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于效用的客户选择理论、市场细分理论、运输成本连续近似理论、时间整合配送优化理论
AI.method: 开发分析框架，整合客户选择模型和运输成本连续近似，进行数学建模和优化分析，推导闭式解，进行参数敏感性分析
AI.findings: 1. 同时提供订阅和按订单的时间整合计划严格优于单独提供任一方案；2. 推导出最优按订单价格的闭式解；3. 最优配送频率取决于客户订单频率分布；4. 在低密度市场和客户对配送延迟具有中高容忍度时，TC配送优于当日达
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了整合客户选择和运输成本的分析框架；2. 建立了时间整合配送的优化模型；3. 提供了TC配送与当日达的比较分析理论；4. 推导了最优定价和配送频率的闭式解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为物流服务提供商提供定价和配送频率设计指导；2. 识别了TC配送在低密度市场的优势；3. 为可持续最后一公里物流提供可行方案；4. 为欠服务地区的服务扩展提供决策支持

title: Borrower-Based Mortgage Measures: Lessons from Ireland’s Experience since 2015
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Borrower-Based Mortgage Measures: Lessons from Ireland’s Experience since 2015

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 4
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We draw lessons from research and analysis into borrower-based mortgage measures in Ireland, using granular and comprehensive micro-data for the Irish mortgage market, and a wide range of empirical identification strategies. We find that lenders maintained credit growth following the introduction of mortgage measures in 2015. Borrowers changed their behaviour, particularly those who were faced with liquidity and leverage constraints. Borrower resilience benefits can already be discerned, but the full benefits would accrue after an adverse economic shock. We discuss the role of housing market conditions in calibration, and the benefits of including non-bank mortgage lenders under the measures. Finally, we propose questions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文使用爱尔兰抵押贷款市场的细粒度微观数据，通过多种实证识别策略，研究了基于借款人的抵押贷款措施的影响。研究发现，2015年引入抵押贷款措施后，贷款机构保持了信贷增长，借款人行为发生变化，特别是面临流动性和杠杆约束的借款人。借款人韧性效益已显现，但完全效益需在不利经济冲击后实现。文章讨论了住房市场条件在校准中的作用，以及将非银行抵押贷款机构纳入措施的好处。
AI.research_question: 基于借款人的抵押贷款措施（如爱尔兰2015年引入的措施）如何影响信贷市场？这些措施对贷款机构行为和借款人行为产生什么影响？借款人韧性效益何时显现？住房市场条件在校准中起什么作用？是否应将非银行抵押贷款机构纳入监管范围？
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰在2015年引入了基于借款人的抵押贷款措施，旨在增强金融稳定性和借款人韧性。然而，这些措施的实际效果需要实证评估，特别是在不同市场条件下的影响，以及是否应将非银行贷款机构纳入监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于借款人的宏观审慎政策理论、信贷市场理论、借款人行为理论、流动性约束理论、杠杆约束理论、金融稳定理论。
AI.method: 使用爱尔兰抵押贷款市场的细粒度微观数据，采用多种实证识别策略进行分析，包括比较分析、因果推断等方法。
AI.findings: 1. 贷款机构在措施引入后保持了信贷增长；2. 借款人行为发生变化，特别是面临流动性和杠杆约束的借款人；3. 借款人韧性效益已开始显现，但完全效益需在不利经济冲击后实现；4. 住房市场条件对措施校准至关重要；5. 将非银行抵押贷款机构纳入监管范围具有好处。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为基于借款人的宏观审慎政策提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了抵押贷款措施在不同市场条件下的动态效应；3. 拓展了借款人行为对监管政策响应的理论理解；4. 为监管框架的完善提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了抵押贷款措施效果的实际证据；2. 强调了住房市场条件在校准中的重要性；3. 建议将非银行抵押贷款机构纳入监管范围；4. 为未来政策调整和监管设计提供了实践指导；5. 提出了未来研究方向。

title: The Source of Nonprofit Risk Aversion: Theory and Evidence from Hospitals
affiliations: University of Iowa, University of Mississippi and University of Iowa - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Source of Nonprofit Risk Aversion: Theory and Evidence from Hospitals
detail.abstract: We show that donors, not managers, drive risk-averse behavior in nonprofit organizations (NPOs). Theoretically, when donor recognition is tiered (e.g., naming rights vs.\ thank-you cards), donors concentrate rather than diversify giving, making shadow donation capital costs sensitive to NPO-specific risk. This induces risk-averse actions even without risk-averse managers. We test our theory using hospitals and the staggered adoption of medical liability caps and find that reduced NPO risk increases donations. Effects on substitute bond-financing indicate this increase is supply- (donor-) driven, not demand- (manager-) driven. Liability caps lead nonprofit hospitals to expand risky investments faster than for-profits, improving patient health.

AI.tldr: 研究发现非营利组织中的风险规避行为主要源于捐赠者而非管理者。当捐赠者根据捐赠金额获得不同层级的认可时，他们会集中捐赠而非分散，这使得影子捐赠资本成本对组织特定风险敏感，从而促使组织采取风险规避行为，即使管理者本身并不风险规避。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织中的风险规避行为是由捐赠者还是管理者驱动的？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为非营利组织的风险规避行为源于风险规避的管理者，但本文提出捐赠者行为可能是更重要的驱动因素，特别是在分层捐赠认可机制下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层捐赠认可理论：当捐赠者根据捐赠金额获得不同层级的认可时，他们会集中捐赠而非分散，这使得影子捐赠资本成本对组织特定风险敏感，从而促使组织采取风险规避行为。
AI.method: 使用医院数据和交错采用医疗责任上限的自然实验，检验风险降低对捐赠的影响，并通过替代债券融资效应区分供给（捐赠者）驱动与需求（管理者）驱动。
AI.findings: 1. 降低非营利组织风险会增加捐赠；2. 对替代债券融资的影响表明这种增加是供给（捐赠者）驱动而非需求（管理者）驱动；3. 责任上限使非营利医院比营利性医院更快扩大风险投资，改善患者健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出捐赠者驱动的风险规避理论，挑战传统管理者风险规避观点；2. 建立分层捐赠认可机制如何影响捐赠者集中捐赠行为的理论框架；3. 阐明影子捐赠资本成本对组织特定风险的敏感性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非营利组织管理者提供理解捐赠者行为对组织风险承担影响的新视角；2. 为政策制定者设计医疗责任改革提供实证依据；3. 显示降低非营利组织风险可以促进捐赠和改善患者健康结果。

title: Entanglement Entropy as a Universal Market Bottom Indicator: Evidence from Global Equity Markets

detail.title: Entanglement Entropy as a Universal Market Bottom Indicator: Evidence from Global Equity Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We propose that financial market crises can be characterized by a quantity we call "market entanglement entropy," defined as S(t) =-1 N log det Σ(t), where Σ(t) is the rolling correlation matrix of asset returns. This indicator is motivated by holographic duality in theoretical physics, where entanglement entropy plays a central role. Contrary to initial expectations that high entropy predicts crashes, we find that maximum entropy corresponds to market bottoms-the point of maximum correlation where recovery becomes likely. Out-of-sample testing across three major markets (US, Japan, Germany) from 2020-2026 shows: 90.4% win rate for US (p < 10-47), 87.0% for Japan (p < 10-32), and 95.1% for Germany (p < 10-24). The indicator outperforms VIX-based strategies with a Sharpe ratio of 1.31 versus 0.86. These findings suggest that correlation-based entropy measures capture information about market dynamics that volatility alone does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"市场纠缠熵"指标，基于资产收益滚动相关矩阵定义，发现最大熵对应市场底部而非顶部，在三大市场测试中表现优异，优于VIX策略。
AI.research_question: 市场纠缠熵能否有效预测金融市场危机？最大熵对应的是市场顶部还是底部？
AI.motivation: 传统波动率指标如VIX在预测市场危机时存在局限，需要新的指标来捕捉市场动态信息。理论物理中的全息对偶和纠缠熵概念为金融市场分析提供了新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理论物理中的全息对偶和纠缠熵理论；金融市场相关性和系统性风险理论；信息论中的熵概念。
AI.method: 定义市场纠缠熵S(t)=-1/N log det Σ(t)，其中Σ(t)为资产收益滚动相关矩阵；在美、日、德三大市场进行样本外测试（2020-2026年）；与VIX策略进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1. 最大熵对应市场底部而非顶部；2. 样本外测试表现优异：美国90.4%胜率，日本87.0%，德国95.1%；3. 夏普比率1.31优于VIX的0.86。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将理论物理的纠缠熵概念引入金融市场分析；2. 提出基于相关性的熵指标能捕捉波动率无法反映的市场信息；3. 挑战了"高熵预测崩盘"的传统预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供有效的市场底部预测工具；2. 为投资者提供优于VIX的交易策略；3. 可用于风险管理、资产配置和危机预警。

title: The Great Re-Bordering of the Tariff Framework: The End of Free Trade as We Knew It
affiliations: System for International Law and Order L.L.C. (SiLO)

detail.title: The Great Re-Bordering of the Tariff Framework: The End of Free Trade as We Knew It
detail.abstract: The second Trump administration marked a decisive break from the postwar multilateral trade order. For decades, global trade rested on predictability: bound tariff schedules, negotiated concessions, and dispute resolution through institutions such as the WTO. On April 2, 2025, however, President Trump declared “Liberation Day”—not from foreign rule, but from what his administration described as decades of unfair trade practices. Unlike the more targeted “Phase One” approach of his first term, the second term introduced a two-track strategy. One track imposed broad “baseline” and “reciprocal” tariffs designed to force market-access negotiations. The other relied on targeted use of Section 232 to shield strategically vital industries, including semiconductors and critical minerals. This was not a policy adjustment. It was a unilateral declaration that the post–World War II free-trade consensus was over.

AI.tldr: 特朗普第二任期标志着战后多边贸易秩序的彻底转变，通过"基线"和"互惠"关税以及232条款保护战略产业，单方面宣告二战后自由贸易共识的终结。
AI.research_question: 特朗普第二任期的贸易政策如何标志着与战后多边贸易秩序的彻底决裂？
AI.motivation: 研究特朗普第二任期贸易政策的根本性转变，理解其对全球贸易体系的系统性影响，以及这种转变如何挑战了数十年的多边贸易框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边贸易理论、单边主义贸易政策、战略性贸易保护理论、制度变迁理论。
AI.method: 政策文本分析、历史比较分析、案例研究（聚焦"解放日"宣言、基线关税、互惠关税、232条款应用）。
AI.findings: 特朗普第二任期采用双轨策略：1）通过广泛"基线"和"互惠"关税强制市场准入谈判；2）利用232条款保护半导体和关键矿产等战略产业。这不仅是政策调整，而是对二战后自由贸易共识的单方面宣告终结。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了单边主义贸易政策的理论框架；2）提供了制度变迁理论在贸易领域的实证案例；3）深化了对战略性贸易保护的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供理解贸易政策根本性转变的框架；2）为企业提供应对单边贸易政策的策略指导；3）为国际组织提供应对贸易秩序变化的参考。

title: Thirty Years of American Income Inequality Through the Lens of Statistical Mechanics: From Thermal Equilibrium to Superthermal Dominance (1994-2024)

detail.title: Thirty Years of American Income Inequality Through the Lens of Statistical Mechanics: From Thermal Equilibrium to Superthermal Dominance (1994-2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Here is a simple question: is the U.S. income distribution still in equilibrium? We answer it with thirty years of data. We fit the Census Bureau household income distribution (1994-2024) to a two-regime model: an exponential bulk P (m) ∝ e-m/T for incomes below a threshold mc, and a Pareto tail P (m) ∝ m-α above it. Four numbers tell the story. (1) Economic temperature T rose from $97k to $167k (2024 constant dollars). (2) The fraction of households in the Pareto tail expanded from 1.2% to 10.1%. (3) The Pareto exponent α fell from approximately 3.2 to 1.70, crossing α = 2-the point where the tail mean diverges-in 2023. (4) The exponential goodness-of-fit R 2 exp declined from 0.82 to 0.62, meaning the bulk is losing its equilibrium shape. All four indicators point the same direction. The U.S. income distribution crossed a statistical boundary in 2023 that has a concrete meaning: there is no longer a stable average characterizing the high-income population.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用30年数据分析了美国家庭收入分布，发现收入分布已偏离均衡状态：经济温度上升，帕累托尾部分布扩大，帕累托指数跌破临界值2，指数拟合度下降，表明高收入群体已无稳定平均值。
AI.research_question: 美国家庭收入分布是否仍处于均衡状态？
AI.motivation: 理解美国收入不平等的变化趋势及其统计特征，特别是高收入群体分布是否仍具有稳定统计特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两区域收入分布模型：指数分布描述低收入群体（均衡状态），帕累托分布描述高收入群体（幂律尾）。帕累托指数α=2是临界点，决定尾部均值是否收敛。
AI.method: 使用美国人口普查局1994-2024年家庭收入数据，拟合两区域模型：阈值mc以下为指数分布P(m)∝e^{-m/T}，阈值以上为帕累托分布P(m)∝m^{-α}。分析四个关键指标随时间变化。
AI.findings: 1) 经济温度T从9.7万美元升至16.7万美元；2) 帕累托尾部家庭比例从1.2%增至10.1%；3) 帕累托指数α从约3.2降至1.70，2023年跌破α=2临界值；4) 指数拟合优度R²从0.82降至0.62。所有指标显示收入分布已偏离均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了收入分布偏离均衡状态的统计证据，特别是帕累托指数跌破α=2这一理论临界点，表明高收入群体已无稳定平均值，对收入不平等理论有重要贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了收入不平等加剧的量化证据，特别是高收入群体统计特性的根本变化，对税收政策、社会保障和经济稳定政策有重要启示。

title:
Home, Choice & Care: 
Rethinking Retirement Living in New Zealand
affiliations: Massey University, Massey University - School of Economics and Finance, Massey University - Massey University Auckland, Massey University - School of Economics and Finance, Massey University, Massey University - Massey University Auckland and Massey University - Massey University Auckland

detail.title:
Home, Choice & Care: 
Rethinking Retirement Living in New Zealand
detail.abstract:
The retirement village sector in New Zealand has emerged as an increasingly significant component of the country's broader housing and aged care systems, responding to the evolving demographic structure and socio-economic realities of an ageing population. As life expectancy rises, the demand for purpose-designed, age-friendly living environments is growing rapidly outpacing the capacity of current infrastructure, regulatory frameworks, and prevailing business models to adequately respond. The retirement village industry is not only an economic enterprise but also a critical area of social policy, urban planning, and intergenerational equity. Its development has far-reaching implications for the wellbeing of the broader community, influencing how communities remain inclusive and connected, and how resources are distributed across generations to support health, housing, and social cohesion. New Zealand’s ageing population is expanding significantly, mirroring broader global demographic shifts. According to Statistics New Zealand, the number of individuals aged 75 and over will reach approximately 858,000 by 2058. Within this cohort, the proportion of population over 85 years old is expected to grow markedly, from 1.8% of the total population in 2022 to 5.3% by 2058 which underscores the increasing demand for retirement-related systems. This transition maps the urgency of reassessing how retirement living is conceptualised, financed, and delivered. Retirement villages offer an increasingly popular form of accommodation for elderly adults, combining independent living with access to healthcare services and social engagements. However, the rapid growth of the sector raises critical questions about affordability, accessibility, governance, and long-term sustainability.
This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the New Zealand retirement village industry, structured around four principal areas of inquiry. The second section examines the macro-level trends underpinning the expansion of the sector, including population ageing, existing market scale, penetration rate, and growth forecast. The third section presents a detailed examination of the business model and financial analysis of leading market participants. The fourth section critically evaluates alternative approaches to retirement living. This section includes typical models such as residential care homes, ageing in place and community-based services. This analysis sheds light on the trade-offs embedded within each model, demonstrating how structural choices would shape the financial wellbeing of residents. The fifth section presents findings from our public surveys and resident interviews to better understand consumer sentiment. Particular attention is paid to issues of respondents’ intention, market and service demand, and future prospect of the aged-care industry. It also identifies areas that should be involved to better align with the expectations of local community, which comprises individuals with diverse cultural, asset profiles, and health backgrounds.
Adopting interdisciplinary and evidence-based approaches, this report seeks to offer a comprehensive analysis of both the structural dynamics and normative challenges shaping the development of New Zealand’s retirement village industry. It deepens the understanding of the current landscape of the aged care and retirement living market in New Zealand. The report aims to inform public policy development, support strategic decision-making by investors, and promote innovation in housing and healthcare models that are inclusive, sustainable, and ethically responsible.

AI.tldr: 该报告全面分析了新西兰退休村行业，涵盖人口老龄化趋势、商业模式、替代养老模式及消费者调研，旨在为政策制定、投资决策和创新养老模式提供依据。
AI.research_question: 新西兰退休村行业如何应对人口老龄化带来的挑战？其商业模式、替代方案及消费者需求如何影响行业的可持续发展和包容性？
AI.motivation: 新西兰人口老龄化加速，75岁以上人口预计2058年达85.8万，85岁以上比例从1.8%增至5.3%，现有基础设施、监管框架和商业模式难以满足需求，退休村作为融合居住、医疗和社交的养老模式日益重要，但面临可负担性、可及性、治理和可持续性等关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科分析框架，结合人口统计学、经济学（商业模式分析）、公共政策（社会政策、代际公平）、城市规划（适老化环境）和社会学（社区包容性）等多学科视角。
AI.method: 采用证据驱动方法：1) 宏观趋势分析（人口数据、市场规模、渗透率、增长预测）；2) 商业模式与财务分析（主要市场参与者）；3) 替代养老模式比较分析（养老院、原地养老、社区服务）；4) 公众调查和居民访谈（消费者意愿、市场需求、服务需求、行业前景）。
AI.findings: 报告通过四部分分析：1) 宏观趋势显示需求快速增长超出当前供给能力；2) 商业模式分析揭示主要参与者的运营与财务特征；3) 替代模式比较显示不同选择对居民财务福祉的影响；4) 消费者调研反映多元文化、资产和健康背景人群的差异化需求与期望。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 构建了退休村行业的跨学科分析框架；2) 深化了对养老居住市场结构动态的理解；3) 揭示了商业模式选择与居民财务福祉之间的理论联系；4) 为代际公平、社会包容性等规范性问题提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 为公共政策制定提供依据；2) 支持投资者的战略决策；3) 促进包容、可持续和负责任的住房与医疗模式创新；4) 帮助行业更好地满足多元社区期望，提升服务质量。
